business_summary: GEOSTR Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of precast concrete products for civil engineering in Japan. The company provides shield tunnels, precast box and arch culverts, earthquake-resistant precast culverts, mountain tunnels, bridges, earth retaining walls and structures, simple bridge and precast piers, concrete slabs, precast seawalls and guard fences, tunnel linings, precast RC pavements, precast concrete panels, and precast tunnels. Its products are used in construction of roads, railroads, water and sewage systems, retention ponds and flood control measures, river and waterways, electricity/gas/utility tunnels, reservoirs, dams, ports, airports, and defense projects. The company was formerly known as Nippon Concrete Industries Co., Ltd. and changed its name to GEOSTR Corporation in July 1994. GEOSTR Corporation was founded in 1958 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Takamisawa Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of secondary concrete products, ready-mixed concrete, gravel, sand, cement, and other construction materials in Japan. It operates through Construction Related Business, Electrical Materials Business, Car Life Related Business, and Housing/Lifestyle Related Business segments. The Construction Related Business segment manufactures and sells secondary concrete products, ready-mixed concrete, gravel, and sand, as well as engages in contract construction. The Electrical Materials Business segment sells electrical materials, industrial equipment, and air conditioning systems. The Car Life Related Business segment sells petroleum products and sells and maintains automobiles. The Housing/Lifestyle Related Business segment includes individual consumers related to various lifestyles, such as real estate transactions, and food manufacturing and sales. The company also engages in truck transportation, treatment and disposal of general waste and industrial waste, demolition work of buildings and its collection and transportation, sale of fruits and vegetables, sale of fertilizer, food processing and sale, import and sale of corn cob, real estate sales, mediation and management, non-life insurance agency business, golf driving range management, production and sales of mineral water cheese processing, and production and sales of confectionery products. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Nagano, Japan.

Yamau Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells concrete products in Japan. The company is involved in the in the development and manufacturing of secondary concrete products such as FA boxes, and L-shaped retaining walls; manufacturing of steel structures, such as sluice gates and dust collectors; develop and design sluice gates to control agricultural water, and dust removal equipment remove river debris, development, design, and on-site installation; Geological survey, consulting services, and civil engineering projects; planning, research, planning, design, and construction management; and construction consultant specializing in the maintenance of civil engineering structures, including bridges. It also offers Sales and maintenance of information office equipment services. The company was formally known as Yamau Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yamau Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2021. Yamau Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

Yamax Corp. engages in the provision of civil engineering and architectural cement products in Japan. The company offers cement products for civil engineering, such as road and landscape products. It also manufactures and sells precast concrete secondary products for buildings such as PC walls, beams, columns, balconies, and floors for detached houses; and engages in real estate-related businesses such as the construction and sale of wooden houses, the sale of real estate, and the development of residential land. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Kumamoto, Japan.

Ito Yogyo Co., Ltd engages in the manufacture and sale of semi-dry cast concrete products in Japan. It operates through Concrete-related business; Construction equipment-related business; and Real estate-related business segments. The company offers road-related and Bicon products. It also imports and sells environmentally friendly products for use in sewage, landscaping, and water treatment; sells, installs, and maintains products for building equipment, such as air conditioning and water supply and drainage systems; and involved the leasing of rental apartments and office buildings. Ito Yogyo Co., Ltd was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Vertex Corporation manufactures and sells concrete secondary products in Japan. The company operates through the Concrete Business, Pile Business, Slope Disaster Prevention Project, and Others segments. Its Concrete Business segment engages in flood countermeasure and sewerage projects that offer disaster prevention and mitigation solutions, including water disaster countermeasures and seismic retrofitting of sewer facilities; road construction; railway business that offer hard concrete and special mortar; maintenance business; and housing and development business. This segment is also involved in the manufacture and sale of precast concrete products, such as manholes, concrete pipes, box culvert, and related products, as well as provision of installation work. The Pile Business segment engages in the manufacture and sale of centrifugal caprestressed concrete piles, as well as carrying out of pile driving work. Its Slope Disaster Prevention Project segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of disaster prevention products, such as rockfall and landslide protection fences, as well as sale and installation of related products. The Others segment engages in the manufacture and sale of ceramic and tunnel segment products, sale of hydraulic hoses, real estate rental, system development and sales, equipment rental and material sales, and RFID business. In addition, the company is involved in the concrete survey and testing business. Vertex Corporation was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of carbon-related products and services in Japan. It offers graphite electrodes for use in electric furnaces, such as direct current, alternating current, and refining furnaces; and carbon black, including SEAST, TOKABLACK, Aqua Black, and Thermax black varieties, which are used to reinforce the rubber in tires, as well as used as a black pigment in various black-colored products. The company provides fine carbon products comprising special graphite products that include isotropic graphite G/HK series, extruded graphite, SiC coated carbon, C/C composite, glassy carbon, solid SiC, carbon brushes, and resin-impregnated graphite products, as well as furnace materials for silicon semiconductor, solar cell manufacturing, and other applications; and industrial furnaces and related products, which comprise silicon carbide heating elements, resistors, recryte SiC structural materials, and industrial furnaces for heat treatment of ceramics, electronic components, metals, glass, and others. In addition, it offers carbon and graphite products and solutions for various smelting applications, consisting of cathodes, furnace linings, and carbon electrodes; and friction materials, including sintered metal friction, paper friction, sliding, resin, woven, and soft mold materials to regulate power transmission in industrial and construction machinery, as well as for use in brake and clutch parts of vehicles, such as motorbikes and trains. Further, the company provides anode materials for secondary lithium-ion batteries that are used in smartphones and electric cars. The company was formerly known as Tokai Electrode Mfg. Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. in 1975. Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nippon Carbon Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of carbon products in Japan. The company provides carbon fiber products, such as molded heat insulating materials for high temperature furnaces; CARBORON, a soft felt used in heat insulators for high temperature furnaces; C/C Composite, a lightweight carbon material used in heat resistant composite structural members, high temperature furnace materials, trays, and jigs; and CARBEST, a carbon fiber packing material. It offers specialty carbon products, including isotropic graphite; high purity treatment graphite used for manufacturing device components for silicon and compound semiconductors, and optical fibers; carbon products for mechanical components comprising bearings, vane materials, seals, packaging, rings, and mechanical seals; BESCOAT, a silicon carbide coated products; and SC CARBON sliding composites. In addition, the company offers artificial graphite electrodes for use in high power electric arc furnaces; silicon carbide continuous fibers, such as Nicalon, Hi-Nicalon, and Hi-Nicalon Type S for use as composite reinforcement in ceramic, plastic, and other materials; and lithiumion secondary batteries used for cellular and smart phones, NBPC, tablet terminals, power tools, hybrid automobiles, and electric automobiles. Further, it provides impervious graphite RESBON, a corrosion resistant material; NICABEADS, which are surface coated micro bead shape materials; and NICAFILM, a flexible graphite sheet made from natural graphite. Nippon Carbon Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1915 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Sec Carbon,Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of graphite electrodes for steel and carbon products in Japan, the United States, Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and internationally. It offers aluminum smelting cathode blocks, artificial graphite electrodes, special carbon products, fine powders, etc that are used in electric arc furnaces for steelmaking; and carbon and graphite specialties and materials for use in the chemical, electrochemistry, machine, and metallurgy industries. The company also provides fine powder that is used in various industries, such as automobile paint, sliding materials, metallurgic uses, and batteries. In addition, it is also involved in research and development related to molten salt electrolysis. The company was formerly known as SEC Corporation and changed its name to Sec Carbon,Limited in October 2006. Sec Carbon,Limited was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

Toyo Tanso Co., Ltd. produces and sells carbon materials in Japan and internationally. The company provides isotropic graphite products for use in semiconductor, renewable energy, mold, and atomic power industries; carbon-carbon composite materials for use in electronics, environment and energy, general industrial furnaces, automobile industries, and other means of transport; and PERMA-FOIL, a flexible graphite sheet that is used as a seal to note automotive gaskets and packing. It also offers mechanical carbon products, such as bearings, seal rings for mechanical and joint seals, packing, vanes, valve seats, contact strips for pantograph, injection molding product, and sintered carbon graphite product; and carbon brush. In addition, the company provides CNovel, a porous carbon; EVEREDKOTE-C, a high-purity isotropic graphite substrate; PERMA KOTE, a SiC coated graphite for use in the semiconductor manufacturing industry; PYROGRAPH, pyrolytic graphite coating; GLASTIX KOTE, a graphite substrate impregnated or coated with glass-like carbon; Toyo siliconized graphite SiC/C composites; and KLASTA MATE, a metal/carbon composite. Further, it offers technical services, such as machining, heat treatment, high purity treatment, surface treatment, impregnation, forming, and measurement. The company was formerly known as Kondo Carbon Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Toyo Tanso Co., Ltd. in November 1949. The company was founded in 1941 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

Noritake Co., Limited with its subsidiaries, provides industrial, ceramic and material, and engineering products in Japan and internationally. It offers grinding and polishing tools comprising grinding wheels, CBN wheels, diamond tools, coated abrasives, coolants, and recycled products; ceramics and materials, such as vacuum fluorescent display, electronic ceramic powders, thick film circuit substrate, decoration materials, engineering ceramics, electronic paste, and gypsum. The company also provides engineering products comprising heating furnaces/kilns, actuator-less line mixers and related equipment, cutting machines, and filtration systems; and tabletop products, including chinaware for family table, gift, and ornament, as well as tableware for professional and institutional use. The company was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

TOTO LTD. manufactures and sells bathroom and plumbing fixtures worldwide. The company provides sanitary ware comprising toilet basins, urinals, sinks, washbasins, etc.; system toilets, toilet seats, plumbing accessories, bathtubs, and unit bathrooms; and fittings, such as various faucets, drain fittings, etc. It also offers modular kitchens, bathroom vanity units, marbright artificial marble counters, and welfare equipment; bathroom ventilation, heating, and drying systems; green building materials, such as tiles, ceramic slabs, etc.; and ceramics. The company was formerly known as TOTO Kiki Ltd. and changed its name to TOTO LTD. in 2007. TOTO LTD. was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Kitakyushu, Japan.

NGK Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells electric power related equipment in Japan, rest of Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Environment Business, Digital Society Business, and Energy & Industry Business. The company offers suspension, long rod, station post, hollow, pin post, and RTV silicone rubber insulators; hardware for insulator and assemblies; bushing; energy plant equipment; special metals and mold products, such as beryllium copper, copper-nickel-tin, beryllium, and mold products. It also provides ceramic heaters, electrostatic chucks, and components; C1 Home-Use water purifier; HONEYCERAM, a ceramic structure that carries a catalyst that neutralizes the harmful substances found in vehicle exhaust; Diesel Particulate Filters which eliminate particulate in the exhaust gas emitted from diesel automobiles; and Nox sensors for engine exhaust gas. In addition, the company offers wafer, piezoceramic actuators, translucent alumina ceramics, zirconia, Micro-Lens for UV-LED, HTCC, AMB substrate for power modules, and general pressed products, as well as EnerCera, a Li-ion rechargeable battery; industrial heating, kiln furniture and refractories, ceramic membranes and separators, glass-lining products, high-temperature dust collector, ceramic and vacuum pump, gas analyzer, and organic compound crystal search services. Its products are used for mobility, electronics, social infrastructure, environment, industrial equipment, medical and healthcare, daily living, aircraft, ship, and space-related applications. NGK Corporation was formerly known as NGK Insulators, Ltd. and changed its name to NGK Corporation in April 2026. The company was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Niterra Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells spark plugs and related products for internal-combustion engines and technical ceramics in Japan and internationally. The company offers spark plugs, including plugs for aftermarket and original equipment, igniter plugs, and resistor cables and covers; glow plugs comprising ceramic and metal type glow plugs, and glow controllers; and oxygen, NOx, temperature, and knock sensors. It also provides semiconductor packages used in all kinds of products, including smartphones, cameras, and cars, as well as manufacturing parts for semiconductors, and medical products. In addition, the company offers fine ceramics, balls for bearings, piezoelectric ceramics, other industrial ceramics such as plungers for pumps and ceramic protective plates, including wear-resistant parts, ultrasonic transducers and sensors, products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, electric equipment products, and other ceramic products. Further, it provides cutting tools comprising ceramic, micro grain carbide, coated carbide, and cubic boron nitride grades, as well as SS and rotational tools; and sumikaze, a sterilization deodorizer utilizes ozone to purify the air and inhibit invisible harmful substances and viruses. The company sells its spark and glow plugs under the NGK brand; and sensors, semiconductor packages/substrates, cutting tools, oxygen concentrators, and piezoelectric and fine ceramics under the NTK brand. The company was formerly known as NGK Spark Plug Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Niterra Co., Ltd. in April 2023. Niterra Co., Ltd. was founded in 1936 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Danto Holdings Corporation manufactures, sells, and installs ceramics and related products in Japan. The company operates through Construction Ceramics and Related Products Business; Real Estate Business; Housing Finance Business; Generator Business; and Renewable Energy Business segments. It offers gold interior, exterior, floor, mosaic tiles, and tile installation materials; real estate asset management and investment advisory; real estate leasing; and housing loans, as well as develops, manufactures, and sells emergency LPG generators; install and operate integrated battery storage systems; and manufacturing, sales, and installation of construction ceramics and related products. The company was formerly known as Danto Company and changed its name to Danto Holdings Corporation in 2006. Danto Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1885 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Asahi Eito Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of sanitary and washbasin equipment. It operates through Housing Business, Living Business, and Investment business segments. The company engages in the sale of architectural finishing coating materials; solar power generation and battery storage system installation; facility management; and real estate business. It is also involved in the drone school business, nursery school business, and building management association operation activities; and industrial gas business. The company was formerly known as Asahi Eito Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Asahi Eito Holdings Co.,Ltd. in May 2023. Asahi Eito Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Maruwa Co.,Ltd. produces and sells ceramics and electronic parts in Japan and internationally. It operates through Ceramic Components Business and Lighting Equipment segments. The company offers ceramics, including ceramic substrates and fillers, metalized/multilayer ceramic substrates, pressed ceramic products, ceramic hermetic seals, and ultra-high purity SiC components; and electronic components and devices, such as antennas, EMC and RF components, and capacitors. It also provides semiconductor products comprising quartz glass products, including quartz tubes and boats; and aluminum nitride components. In addition, the company offers LED lighting products comprising LED streetlights, LED tunnel lights, and LED landscape lights; and technical consultation services. Its products are used in automotive, telecommunications, semiconductors, industrial equipment, and lighting applications. The company was formerly known as Maruwa Ceramic Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Maruwa Co., Ltd. in 1999. Maruwa Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Owariasahi, Japan.

Shinagawa Refra Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of refractory products in Japan and internationally. The company offers shaped refractory bricks, including basic, carbon-containing, fire clay and high alumina, silicon carbide, and silica bricks; monolithic refractories comprising castable and gunning refractories, precast shapes, plastic and ramming mixes, and refractory mortars; and functional products for continuous casting, such as slide gate plate bricks, submerged entry nozzles, monoblock stoppers, and ladle shrouds, as well as mold powder for continuous casting. It also provides ceramic fiber in various forms consisting of modules, preformed shapes, refractory insulating boards, sheets, and gaskets; and fine ceramics, including high precision large-sized ceramic parts, as well as alumina, zirconia, silicon carbide, a-Sialon, and porous ceramics for use in liquid crystal and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. In addition, the company offers multifunctional absorbent and desiccants, and inorganic heat-resistant paints and adhesives; and related products. Further, it designs, installs, and maintains various industrial kilns and furnaces. The company's products are used in the blast furnace, RH degasser, torpedo car, converter, casting, incinerator, glass furnace, and cement rotary kiln applications. Shinagawa Refra Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shinagawa Refractories Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shinagawa Refra Co., Ltd. in October 2025. The company was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Nippon Crucible Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of refractory products primarily in Japan. The company offers refractories for iron steel making, cast iron and cast steel, non-ferrous metals, and high technology products; and various furnaces, including MEL-keeper, NM furnaces. It is also involved in design, manufacture, and sales to the maintenance of facilities; and real estate business. The company was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nikkato Corporation manufactures and sells industrial ceramic consumables in Japan. The company operates through the Ceramics Business and Engineering Business segments. The Ceramics Business segment manufactures and sells ceramic tools; fixtures; tubes; protection and insulating tubes; firing containers; crucibles; setters; balls; wear-resistant components; and machine parts used in the production processes of manufacturers of electronic components, food, pharmaceuticals, paints, and other products, as well as ceramics and other materials for scientific and chemical use. The Engineering Business segment purchases and sells measurement and control equipment, heating equipment, and temperature sensors. It also offers electric furnaces and laboratory porcelain. The company was founded in 1913 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

Japan Insulation Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of calcium silicate products in Japan. It also manufactures and sells non-combustible building materials; sells heat-retaining and cold-insulating materials, as well as designs and carries out heat-retaining, cold-insulating, insulating, and fire-resistant construction work. The company also offers thermal insulation materials for plant equipment, fire-resistant cladding materials for plant equipment, fire-resistant cladding materials for the design of general buildings, non-combustible interior materials for the design of general buildings, mold material for CFRP, humidity conditioning building materials, board for carving out letters and sculptures, and lightweight inorganic powder. Japan Insulation Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Shinto Company Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of Japanese and Western-style roofing tiles in Japan. The company offers ceramic tiles; and roofing materials, such as system, disaster resistant, and reflective tiles. It is also involved in exporting and development of various roofing materials. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Takahama, Japan.

Mipox Corporation engages in the production and distribution of polishing-related products in Japan and internationally. It offers abrasives and polishing products, such as polishing film, abrasive paper, abrasive cloth, nonwoven fabric abrasive, liquid abrasives, grinding stone, file, sanding disc, and diamond abrasive; polishing and inspection equipment; detergents and lubricants; and reflectors under the Mipox, Nikken, Ref Lite, Nikken MISUMI, Omuni, and Carbonite brands, as well as precision polishing services. The company is also involved in the development and distribution of polishing machines, the production and distribution of liquids, and contract manufacturing. Its products are used in semiconductor, hard disk drive, optical fiber and connector, electronics, PCB and electronic devices, automotive, aerospace, heavy machinery and shipbuilding, metal and hardware, woodworking and construction, resin and CFRP/FRP, solvent-free, polishing equipment, inspection equipment, reflective materials and safety, and other sectors. The company was formerly known as Nihon Micro Coating Co., Ltd and changed its name to Mipox Corporation in August 2013. Mipox Corporation was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Kanuma, Japan.

Fujimi Incorporated manufactures and sells synthetic precision abrasives in Japan, North America, Asia, and Europe. The company offers various products for slicing crystal silicon ingots, lapping, and polishing silicon wafers; abrasives for use in the production of semiconductor devices, such as CMP slurry and other materials; and polishing products for magnetic disks of the hard disk drives. It also provides polishing solutions, including lapping, polishing, and diamond products, as well as polishing compounds for use in electronic components, lighting and LED products, automobiles, and lenses industries. In addition, the company offers thermal spray materials for use in aircraft, FDPs and semiconductors, steel, and energy industries. Further, the company offers specialty materials, such as silicon carbide, titanium phosphate, cemented carbide powder, rod-shaped zinc oxide, and alumina. Fujimi Incorporated was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Kiyosu, Japan.

Kunimine Industries Co., Ltd. engages in the mining, manufacture, and sale of bentonite ore in Japan. It operates through Bentonite, Clay Science, and Agriculture segments. The company is involved in the extraction, processing, and sale of rocks and clay; and manufacturing, processing, and sale of inorganic and organic industrial chemicals, agricultural chemicals, medicines, quasi-drugs, and drugs intended for animal use. It also engages in the manufacture, processing, and sale of food, food additives, feed, and feed additives; and design, construction, and operation of plants related to powder and granular material equipment, molding devices and civil engineering equipment, etc.; and manufacture and sale of related equipment and materials. In addition, the company manufactures and sells water treatment and waste water/sewage treatment agents, as well as operates and constructs treatment equipment. Further, it manufactures and sells bentonite-based products for castings, civil engineering and construction, toilet sand for pets, cosmetics, life sciences, and waste disposal. Additionally, the company manufactures, processes, and sells agrochemicals and agrochemical carriers. Kunimine Industries Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

A&A Material Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of building materials and industrial products in Japan. The company operates through the Construction/Building Materials Business and Industrial Product Engineering Business segments. The Construction/Building Materials Business segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of non-combustible building materials, building interior materials and decorative sheets, and low-pressure melamine decorative laminates, as well as the design and construct of fire-resistant construction projects and steel frame fireproofing work. Its Industrial Product Engineering Business segment engages in the manufacture and sale of non-flammable textiles, marine, soundproofing, expansion joints, industrial friction, sealing, thermal insulation, and other various industrial materials and equipment; design and construction of thermal insulation, cooling, air conditioning, soundproofing, and fireproofing works; and real estate rental services. A&A Material Corporation was incorporated in 1924 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nichias Corporation manufactures and sells thermal insulation materials in Japan. It operates through Construction and sale for plants, Industrial Products, High functional Products, Auto parts, and Building Materials segments. It offers sheet, semimetal, metal, and cloth gaskets, pastes and other sealing materials, and gland packings; high performance, PTFE covered and general purpose elastomer; thermal insulation material; fluororesin products, including sheets, rods, films, tapes, pipes, tubes, hoses, bellows, processed products, containers, injection molded, welded products, and corrosion resistant linings; filter related products; autoparts; building materials, construction work, such as hot and cold insulation work, fireproof installation, electric heater tracing work, soundproofing work, and energy saving diagnostic systems. Further, it provides other products and services. It serves electric chemistry and petrochemistry, energy, electronics, residential housing and non- residential, iron and non-ferrous metals, food and drinks, aviation, ship, building, and rail, automobiles, healthcare and medicine, carbon neutrality and decarbonization, environment, and various plant facilities industries. The company was incorporated in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nippon Steel Corporation engages in the steelmaking and steel fabrication, engineering and construction, chemicals and materials, and system solutions businesses in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. Its Steelmaking and Steel Fabrication segment engages in the manufacture and sale of steel products. The company's Engineering and Construction segment engages in the design, manufacture, sale, construction, and supervision of various plants and facilities, energy pipelines, water facilities, industrial machinery and equipment, buildings, building materials and equipment, steel structures, etc.; operation, management, and maintenance of plants and facilities, etc.; waste treatment and recycling business; and electricity, gas, heat, and other supply businesses. Its Chemicals and Materials segment engages in the manufacture and sale of coal-based chemical products, petrochemicals, electronic materials, and materials and components for semiconductors and electronic parts; carbon fiber and composite products; and products that utilize technologies for metal processing. The company's System Solutions segment offers computer system engineering and consulting; and IT-enabled outsourcing services and other services. It also provides steel plates, sheets, and slags; structural steels; pipes and tubes; railway, automotive, and machinery parts; titanium; and stainless steel and electrical steel sheet products for use in various applications, including automotive, construction, energy, railways and shipping, and consumer electronics industries. The company was formerly known as Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal Corporation and changed its name to Nippon Steel Corporation in April 2019. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Kobe Steel, Ltd. engages in the materials, machinery, and electric power businesses worldwide. The company offers steel sheet products, including high-tensile strength, hot and cold rolled, electro-galvanized, and hot-dipped galvanized steel sheets; steel wire rods and bars; and aluminum and steel plates. It also provides steel casting and forging products, such as crankshafts, marine parts, chemical processing equipment, and rolls; materials for plastic molding; and titanium products, copper sheets and strips, and steel powders. In addition, the company offers robots and electric power sources, and welding materials; and machinery products, including standard compressors, tire and rubber machinery products, rotating machinery products, plastic processing machinery products, advanced technology equipment, rolling mill products, and ultra-high-pressure equipment, as well as LNG vaporizers, pressure vessels, brazed aluminum heat exchangers, and micro channel heat exchangers and reactors. Further, it provides signaling, communication, power supply, automatic fare collection, and platform screen door systems; hydraulic and mini hydraulic excavators, mini wheel loaders, and road machinery; construction, metal, forestry, and industrial waste recycling machinery; and crawler and wheel cranes. Additionally, the company generates and supplies electric power; offers material and structural analysis, testing, physical analysis, and other services; manufactures and sells target materials and test equipment; sells and rents detached homes; and provides brokerage, renovation, insurance, and other services, as well as operational management services of public facilities. It also provides services in the field of iron units; and water treatment, waste incineration, PCB detoxification, and soil remediation services. The company was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Nakayama Steel Works, Ltd. engages in the steel, engineering, building materials, and real estate businesses in Japan. It offers steel coil products, including hot, pickled, plated, slit, and striped /pattern coils; and steel plate products, such as thick steel and NP steel plates, leveling sheets, checker plate, and pattern steel sheet, as well as hot rolled steel products. The company also provides bars and wire rod products comprising steel bars, burn-in- coils, and wire rods, as well as lightweight C-shaped steel, pipes, wire rod secondary products, steel billets, and by-products. In addition, it offers steel artificial reefs, breeding reefs, and floating artificial reef recovery; and casting machine engineering products, including rolls, valves, and casting and processing equipment. Further, it engages in manufacturing and processing of lightweight shaped steel sections, electric resistance welded steel pipes, and construction-related products; buying, leasing, brokerage, and sale of real estate properties; and port transportation and freight vehicle transportation businesses. The company provides general shipping and shipping brokerage services; and environmental services. The company was incorporated in 1923 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Godo Steel, Ltd. manufactures and sells steel products in Japan. It operates through Steel business and Agricultural materials business segments. The company offers wire rods for tire chains, stapler needles, and fencing applications; H-beams and channels that are used in construction, civil engineering, and other sectors; structural bars, which are used as materials for making parts of construction and industrial machinery, ships, and other equipment; and rails. It also provides deformed bars used as construction and civil engineering materials; EG joints and anchor plates, and friction welding; and billets. In addition, the company is involved in manufacture and sale of large and medium shapes, rails, structural bars and wire rods, steel bar and wire products, screw rebars, machinery and materials for steel making; and organic fertilizer and compound fertilizers. Godo Steel, Ltd. was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

JFE Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in steel, engineering, and trading businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through the Steel, Engineering, and Trading segments. The Steel segment produces and sells various steel products, processed steel products, and raw materials, as well as transportation, facility maintenance, and construction services. Its Engineering segment is involved in engineering activities for steel structures, industrial machines, energy and environment, recycling, and electricity retailing sectors. The Trading segment purchases, processes, and distributes steel products, raw materials for steelmaking, nonferrous metal, food, and other products. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various steel products in Japan, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers steel building materials, such as H-beams, high-standard electric furnace H-beam, fine sized H-beam (tuned-H), striped H-beams, grooved steel, I-beams, U-shape sheet pile, deformed bars, and cold rolled square steel pipes. It also provides steel plate products, including hot coils, pickling coils, hot-dip galvanized coils, striped coils, cut sheets, and high-standard electric arc furnace steel sheets. Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ARCHION Corporation manufactures and sells commercial vehicles under the FUSO and HINO brands. It offers trucks and buses; light commercial and passenger vehicles, as well as various engines, service parts, etc. The company was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. ARCHION Corporation is a subsidiary of Toyota Motor Corporation.

Kyoei Steel Ltd. engages in the manufacture, processing, and sells of billets and steel products in Japan, Vietnam, Canada, the United States of America, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Domestic Steel Business, Overseas Steel Business, and Environment and Recycling Business. The company offers concrete reinforcing bars; merchant bars, such as flat bars, I beams, equal angle bars, and round bars; billets; and threaded rebars and joints for threaded rebars. It is also involved in the collection, transportation, and treatment of general, industrial, and medical waste; and manufactures and sells casting products. In addition, the company engages in the manufacturing and sale of recycled crushed stone, construction materials, and steel products and raw/secondary materials; contracting business for in-plant loading and unloading; automobile transportation and insurance agency businesses; collection, processing, and sales of iron, aluminum, and nonferrous metal scraps; and construction and operation of multi-purposed seaport. Kyoei Steel Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Yamato Kogyo Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of steel products in Japan and internationally. The company offers H-beam, channel steel, I-beam, equal angle, steel sheet pile, rolled steel for shipbuilding, bent and cast steel products. It also provides trackwork materials, such as turnouts, anti-derailing/deviation guards, expansion joints, NEW crossings, adhesive insulated joint rails, tie plates, and bolts. In addition, it offers jumbo H-beams, Z sheet piles, angles, and rebars. Further, it is involved in the transportation and medical waste treatment, as well as produces counterweight products. The company was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Himeji, Japan.

Tokyo Tekko Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of steel and reinforcing bars in Japan. It offers steel bars for concrete reinforcement, including high-tensile threaded and deformed rebars; mechanical joints, such as threaded rebar and mortar-grouted joints; mechanical anchorages, including mechanical anchorage for threaded rebars and shear reinforcement; rebar processing products; and steel exposed column-base method, including SMART-BASE and SCREW-BASE method products. The company was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

HOKUETSU METAL Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells iron and steel products in Japan. It offers steel bars for reinforced concrete; rolled steel materials for general structures; rolled steel bars for building structures; and mild steel wires bar-in coils, as well as shaped steel products, such as general and building structural shaped steel, and deformed shaped steel. The company also provides building and civil engineering materials, including UN, self-drilling, and steel pipe expansion type bolts; reinforced steel assembly; UHY hoops and U-CON rings; fab deck; mechanical anchoring hardware; turnbuckles; structural anchor bolts; TH pieces; automobile tire chains, and Beveled deformed steel bars, as well as bolt and fittings for various construction and civil engineering. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacture, processing, and sale of machinery; processing and sales of ceramic products, and civil engineering and construction materials; and collecting, transporting, processing, and selling of general and industrial wastes, and recycling products. Further, it engages in the warehousing, and truck and cargo transportation businesses. HOKUETSU METAL Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Nagaoka, Japan.

Osaka Steel Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of steel sections, bars, steel billets and processed steel products for the construction, civil engineering, shipbuilding, steel towers, and industrial machinery manufacturing applications in Japan, the Republic of Indonesia, South Korea, and internationally. It offers equal and unequal angles, channels, I-beams, round, flat and deformed bars, square bars, mechanical joints for reinforcing bars, rails, elevator guide rails, colored angles and channels, deformed and round joints, billets, and other semifinished steel products. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Osaka Steel Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Nippon Steel Corporation.

GMS Group Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of injection molding machines, molds, automated molding systems, and measuring instruments. It also offers die casting machines and related automated equipment. The company was founded in 1925 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Yodoko, Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sales of steel products for industrial and consumer products in Japan. The company offers repainted steel, galvanized steel, chromate-free treated steel, and cold rolled products; building material, such as roofing products, siding products, rooftop greenery systems, solar power generation systems, and installation of roofing and siding; exterior products, including storage sheds, houses, carports, garages, warehouses, trash bins, and bicycle parks; Rolls comprising large machinery components that support manufacturing, including paper, packaging film, and rubber and steel; yodo water falls (overflow-suppression grating), yodo karugaru grating, yodo ex grating, yodo galfan grating, and other gratings; household equipment, household implements, and building materials. It also provides design and contracting construction work, warehousing, packaging and shipping, sale, purchase and leasing of real estate, building of produce cultivation facilities and landscaping, and associated business activities. Yodoko, Ltd. was formerly known as Yodogawa Steel Works, Ltd. and changed its name to Yodoko, Ltd. in October 2025. The company was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Takasago Tekko K.K. manufactures and sells various steel products developed primarily from stainless steel in Japan. The company operates through two segments: Iron and Steel Products Business and Real Estate Business. It offers cold rolled steel products, including cold rolled steel and cold rolled special steel strips; and electromagnetic plates and sheets, such as soft magnetic iron plates and 1% silicon iron sheets. The company also provides embossed stainless steel products comprising RUNNER stainless, ordinary embossed and coated stainless steel products, as well as SUBERANNAR products; and processed stainless steel products that include stainless steel hard plates, high precision pipes, and molded stainless steel products. It is also involved in real estate rental and management business. Takasago Tekko K.K. was incorporated in 1923 and is headquartered in Itabashi, Japan.

Toranvia Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the software development, computer operations management, system solution services, and related businesses. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel plates in Japan. It operates through the Steel Related Business, Rental Business, Logistics Business, and Engineering Business segments. The company also engages in the installation, manufacture, and maintenance of equipment for steel manufacturers; metal processing; and warehouse business that focuses on storage and handling of hazardous goods, such as flammable substance, paint, and medicine. In addition, it is involved in the rental business and advertising business for making advertising signs, as well as offers rental grease-filters and maintenance service for kitchens. The company serves construction machinery, industrial machinery, machine tools and parts, factory equipment, industrial vehicles, infrastructure, construction, and transport sectors. Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Maruichi Steel Tube Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel pipes, surface treated steel sheets, and poles in Japan, North America, and Asia. The company offers structural steel pipes; steel tube for piping; steel conduit and accessories; tubes and accessories for cable protection; synthetic resin-coated tubes for cable protection; lighting and signal pols, and equipment mounting column; and steel sheets. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Mory Industries Inc. manufactures and sells stainless steel and welded carbon steel products in Japan. It offers stainless round pipes and tubes, square and modified tubes, clad and flexible tubes, joint parts, etc.; stainless steel flat, angle, and round bars; stainless steel household products; and various products from stainless steel tubes. The company also provides welded carbon steel tubes for machine and general structural purposes, and welded carbon steel square pipes for general structural purposes, and machinery. Its products are used in construction materials, hardware, furniture, and automotive parts. Mory Industries Inc. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Miraini Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of electronic components, electronic devices, and electronic equipment. It is also involved in the manufacture and sale of FA equipment; development and design of embedded software and various systems; and related businesses. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Daido Steel Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of steel products in Japan and internationally. The company offers specialty steel for automotive parts, industrial machinery parts, electrical machinery parts, construction, and tool steel; stainless steel, nickel-based alloys, electrical and electronics parts, and magnetic material products; alloy powder; titanium products; and welding wire. It is also involved in manufacturing of specialty steel products and materials; distribution; sales of raw materials; real estate, insurance, and analysis businesses; and provision of transportation and logistics, machine maintenance, welfare, and golf course management services. In addition, the company provides die forging, precise hot forging, and welded parts; parts for boats and ships, industrial machines, heavy electric machines, steel making equipment, chemical equipment, oil drilling rigs, and spacecraft and aircraft; manganese railway rails, components for automobiles, industrial machine, electric machine and furnaces, and advanced cast steel products; automotive, industrial machine, electric machine, telecommunications equipment; and lumber industry band saws, engine valves, compressors, hydraulic equipment, and machine tool parts. Further, it offers steel making equipment, industrial furnaces and facilities, and environmental equipment. Additionally, the company provides tool steel and steel for molds, superalloy, strip, formed and fabricated products, target material, new metal, point light source LEDs, permalloy foil, isotropic SmFeN magnetic powder and compounds, and material for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Daido Steel Co., Ltd. was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells stainless steel sheets and processed products in Japan and internationally. The company offers corrosion resistant, heat resistant, controlled expansion, soft magnetic, and non-magnetic alloys; and high strength and neutron absorbing stainless, as well as corrosion resistant pure nickel; other stainless steel products; stainless steel floor plates, including POLKA and Checker plate; and manufacture ferronickel alloys. Its products are used for precision electronics, green technologies, marine structures, automotive, precision astronomical instruments, manufacturing and processing plants, and high-temperature environment industries, as well as in the protection of LNG, neutrons, and overlays applications. The company was formerly known as Nippon Kako Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd. in 1942. Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1925 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Aichi Steel Corporation manufactures and sells steel materials, forged products, electronic functional materials and components, and magnetic products in Japan, the United States, Thailand, China, and internationally. It operates through Steel Company, Stainless Steel Company, Forge Company, Smart Company, and Others segments. The company offers specialty steel products, including carbon and alloy steel for machine structural use, H-shaped steel for structural use, alloy steel bolting materials for high temperature service, microalloyed and boron steel, and spring and high carbon chrome bearing steel; hot and cold work tool steel; stainless steel products, such as angle and unequal angle bars, channel and wide channel bars, flat and square bars, compression bars, welded H-beams and T-bars, round bars, stainless steel bars for concrete reinforcement, and custom welded shaped steel, as well as stainless steel products for high-pressure hydrogen, blades, building structures, and water sluices. It also provides titanium round, angle, and flat bars; forged products, including engine, chassis, transmission, driveline, and e-axle units; ultra-sensitive magnetic/MI sensors, MAGFIT dental magnetic attachments, and MAGFINE bonded magnets; amorphous wires; electronic materials and components, including lead frames, bonding pads, and heat spreaders; and TetsuRiki Agri/Aqua iron fertilizers for crops. In addition, the company is involved in the production of flame retardant materials and forging dies; design and installation of industrial furnaces; mining, processing, and sale of limestone and other minerals; cargo transportation, handling, and storage; software development; and sale and maintenance of computers and accessories. Further, it engages in the sale of daily commodities; and provision of restaurant, lunch catering, and gardening services, etc. Aichi Steel Corporation was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Tokai, Japan.

Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and distributes various types of special steel products in Japan. The company offers heat resistant and stainless steel materials, magnetic materials, and low thermal expansion alloys; special alloys, including ferrous and non-ferrous alloys; precision processed products, such as cold-/warm-forged NNS, torque sensor, automobile high pressure pump parts, and machined and processed composite products; heat treatment products; and automatic coercive force meters. Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1937 and is based in Shibata, Japan. As of June 29, 2026 Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. operates as subsidiary of Daido Steel Co., Ltd.

SystemEXE,Inc. engages in the system integration business. It provides business system development, scratch development, IT infrastructure construction, cloud integration, AI solutions, database services, data utilization, operations and maintenance, PMO support, system migration, DX (digital transformation) solutions, offshore development, groupware workflow, and IoT services, as well as data analysis infrastructure construction and report-based DX promotion solutions. The company serves real estate, manufacturing, non-life and life insurance, medical care, petroleum, chemical, and other industries. SystemEXE,Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Nippon Kinzoku Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cold-rolled and polished stainless-steel strips in Japan and internationally. It also offers magnesium alloy strips, and thin electrical steel strips, as well as engages in the stainless-steel rolling and processing business. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Softtex Co.,Ltd. engages in the computer system design and software development business. It operates through two segments, Software Development Services and Medical IT Services. It offers disaster prevention equipment manufacturers, computer manufacturers, system integrators, and information systems. The company also offers internet-related system services; consultation and education on computer usage; development, sales, and support of software packages; and construction and support of medical systems. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Nagoya, Japan with additional offices in Tokyo, Sapporo, and Okinawa, Japan.

Property Technologies Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides technology solutions and other housing-related services in Japan. It offers KAITRY, a platform with AI assessment model for the purchase and sale of used housing, used detached housing, and renovated used housing, as well as used condominiums. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Realgate Inc. provides real estate services in Japan. The company offers real estate consulting, buying and selling, brokerage, rental, and management and operation services; architecture and design supervision services; and architecture and interior construction contracting services. It also provides non-life insurance agency services, hotel management, and operation management services. Realgate Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Realgate Inc. operates as a subsidiary of CyberAgent, Inc.

Elitz Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the rental real estate brokerage business in Japan. The company is involved in rental unit and management, franchise chain business, real estate consulting, management and planning of condominiums, financial planning, property utilization, monthly apartment operation, tenant and insurance agency, and construction business. It also provides corporate housing support services. The company engages in the house for installment sale and rebuilding business; move and advertisement business; agriculture business; overseas real estate business; delinquency guarantee business; life innovation; and IT development and systems selling business; and worker dispatch business. Elitz Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

MIGALO HOLDINGS Inc. engages in the real estate business in Japan. It operates in two segments, DX Promotion Business and DX Real estate Business. The company is involved in development and sale of condominiums and other properties; real estate brokerage; property and rental management; and apartment and building management activities, as well as the real estate crowdfunding business. It also engages in face recognition platform, system contract development, and cloud integration businesses. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

AlbaLink Co.,Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan. It is also involved in the purchase and resale of vacant houses and properties; purchase and leasing of land; and consulting services related to real estate, as well as provides information on real estate investment through real estate investment forest website. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Pacific Metals Co., Ltd. produces and sells ferro-nickel and ferro-nickel slag products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Nickel, Gas, and other business segments. The company offers ferro-nickel that is used as a raw material for stainless steel; ferro-nickel slag that is used as a civil engineering material. In addition, it is involved in waste recycling business. Further, the company engages in transport contracting and real estate businesses, as well as produces and sells oxygen, argon, and nitrogen gas. The company was formerly known as Nisso Steel Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Pacific Metals Co., Ltd. in January 1970. Pacific Metals Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Hachinohe, Japan.

Shinhokoku Material Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of special alloy materials and precision-machined products in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Special Alloy Business and Real Estate Rental Business. It offers low thermal expansion alloy castings for semiconductor and FPD manufacturing equipment industries; heat resistance casting alloy; wear resistant casting alloy; high-temperature and high-strength alloy castings for the steel industry; alloy for grate of incinerator/alloy for furnace bottom air nozzle of biomass power generation boiler; steel sheets; precision processed parts for semiconductor and FPD manufacturing equipment; and forged products, including bars, wires, etc. The company also provides steel pipe manufacturing tools, and forging and pressing products. In addition, it is involved in real estate leasing business. The company was formerly known as Shinhokoku Steel Corporation and changed its name to Shinhokoku Material Corp. in October 2021. Shinhokoku Material Corp. was founded in 1939 and is headquartered in Kawagoe, Japan.

Batonz Co., Ltd. plan, develops, and operates an M&A support platform to offer business succession matching services via the Internet in Japan. The company offers internet-based M&A matching, management consulting, website planning, production, operation, and management consulting websites using the internet. It provides services such as, M&A Platform, includes matching service, sourcing support services, and FA support services; and M&A SaaS, includes partner program, B MASS, and customer management system. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Nippon Denko Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the ferroalloys, functional materials, incineration ash resource recovery, aqua solutions, and electric power businesses in Japan. The company offers ferroalloys products, including high and low carbon ferromanganese, silomanganese, and ferrosilicon; warehousing, port cargo handling, and functional materials, such as zirconium and boron oxide, metal hydride and boron alloys, storage alloys, manganese inorganic chemical products, and cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries. It also provides eco-melt systems and the utilization of ECOLAROCK, as well as melting and solidification, detoxification treatment/recycling; and aqua solutions comprising wastewater treatment equipment and pure water production systems. In addition, the company is involved in the electric power business and operates dams and power plants. Nippon Denko Co., Ltd. was founded in 1925 and is based in Chuo, Japan.

INUNEKO-SEIKATSU Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells pet food products in Japan. The company offers prepared packaged food for cats and dogs. The company also provides in-house health checkups and blood test services, as well as veterinary clinic and grooming salon services. The company was formerly known as Honest Food Co., Ltd. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Shinjuku, Japan.

Jenoba Co.,Ltd. engages in the positional information data distribution services in Japan. It also develops positional information systems, as well as offers positional information consulting services. It provides services for survey, land and house investigation, construction, agriculture, UAV and drone, and mobility robot applications. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Excite Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the platform, medical, broadband, and SaaS/DX businesses in Japan. It provides various services comprising woman excite, a media platform for working mothers; excite news, a news media platform that provides information, such as news, entertainment, trends, interesting stories, drama and movie reviews, columns, and interviews; Excite Telephone fortune telling, a platform service that sends fortunes through the phone or by email; Excite Advice Room, an online counseling service; EMININAL, a mouthpiece orthopedic treatment system; M&A BASE, a platform that provides mergers and acquisitions (M and A) advisory, intermediation, due diligence and PMI support, and M and A strategy planning; and ONE MEDICAL, an online support system for medical appointments, medical interviews, consultations with doctors, and follow-ups. The company also offers BB Excite, an internet service provider that provides fiber optic lines, internet connection services, SIM cards, smartphones, and others; Job training, a job-seeker support training school; and operates NAPBIZ blog that focuses on managing influencers, as well as undertakes influencer marketing business. In addition, it provides KUROTEN, a business management cloud solution that manages forecasts, management accounting sales results, ledgers, KPIs, and personal data; FanGrowth, a webinar PDCA cloud platform; Sharely, a service that offers support for hosting and running virtual general shareholders' meetings; and Sub, a subscription service introduction support tool. Excite Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Ridge-i Inc. engages in the consulting and development of artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning technologies. The company offers AI utilization consulting and AI development, satellite data AI analysis, data & analytics, generative AI consulting & development, and digital marketing services. Ridge-i Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

ABEJA, Inc. engages in the digital platform business. It offers ABEJA platform, a software suite that provides the processes, including design, development, construction, operation, and enhancement according to the needs of client companies, as well as operates as a digital version of electronics manufacturing service. The company also provides close and ongoing support to its clients. In addition, it offers ABEJA LLM services, such as DX strategy formulation, BPR/business reform, and human resource development/education. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Minato, Japan.

Globee Inc. plans, develops, and operates an AI learning platform in Japan. The company provides abceed, an AI english learning app; and ABCEED ENGLISH, an English coaching school. It also offers abceed for school, which manages learning results, such as study time and assignment progress from creating assignments using various teaching materials. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Minato, Japan.

O.B.System Inc. engages in the system integration service business in Japan. The company offers system consultation services; and develops application software for general-purpose computers, workstations, personal computers, and microcomputers. It also constructs network systems centered on open systems; and develops internet/web systems. The company's products include CLIP, a clinical laboratory system; and MEX-Plus, a health checkup system. O.B.System Inc. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

AR advanced technology, Inc. provides DX solutions utilizing cloud technology, data, and AI in Japan. It offers cnaris, a comprehensive cloud utilization support service; Dataris, a data and AI utilization support service; Mieta, a cloud contact center analysis and management service; LOOGUE series, an AI multi-engine that solves problems in corporate operations; LOOGUE deepdoc, an in-house AI file search service; LOOGUE FAQ, an AI chatbot using AI engine; and ZiDOMA, a file server integrated management solution. The company also provides IT organization DX readiness assessment, digital transformation/project promotion support, contact center system optimization, AWS/cloud implementation support, AWS billing and operation monitoring service, contact center AI utilization service, in-house production support services, advanced design development, and UI/UX design services. In addition, it offers operation automation support, operational automation training, BI implementation and utilization support, cloud healthcare, privileged ID management implementation support, digital BPR, SARMS IT asset management, and invoice agent services. AR advanced technology, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Prodelight Co.,Ltd. provides cloud PBX systems and voice transmission services in Japan. The company engages in the planning, development, and sale of cloud voice systems; and sale of offline services and audio devices. It offers INNOVERA, a cloud phone system; IP-Line, a cloud-direct telephone line; Yealink, a communication terminal; MAXHUB, an electronic blackboard for meetings and classes; and INNOVERA Hikari, an internet optical line. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

GRID Inc. engages in the development, sale, consulting, maintenance, and operation support activities for systems using artificial intelligence (AI). The company offers AI solutions, such as ReNom APPS, an industry SaaS to optimize front-line field operations that support the foundations of society, such as electricity, shipping, SCM, and smart cities. It is also involved in the development, sale, consulting, maintenance, and operation support activities for applications and computer systems; and development, manufacturing, sale, consulting, maintenance, and operation of urban infrastructure solutions, as well as offers internet-based application services and management and consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Laboro.AI Inc. develops and provides custom-made AI solutions using machine learning in Japan. The company also engages in consulting business for introducing custom AI. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Inbound Platform Corp. provides travel-related services for inbound travelers to Japan. It engages in the rental of portable Wi-Fi routers, SIM cards, and pocket translators for international and domestic travelers; and online information and digital solutions to support the daily lives of foreign residents in Japan, as well as campervan/RV rental business. The company also operates a web media platform for tourists coming to Japan; and provides concierge services to customers primarily inbound travelers through its app. In addition, it offers consulting services focused on inbound support for various businesses, including restaurants, retail stores, e-commerce platforms, activity operators, media companies, and transportation infrastructure companies. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Inbound Platform Corp. is a subsidiary of AirTrip Corp.

Fast Accounting Co.,Ltd. provides AI solutions business in Japan. The company offers data entry and verification automation, reconciliation automation, processing, and digital invoice services. Fast Accounting Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

SQUEEZE Inc. designs and develops an artificial intelligence (AI)-based platform for hospitality and tourism industry. The company's platform offers accounting management, revenue management, property management, cloud reception, cleaning and housekeeping, and facility operations services. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Kitahiroshima, Japan.

NETSTARS Co.,Ltd. engages in the QR code payment business in Japan. The company offers StarPay, a multi-QR code payment service that allows users to make payments using QR codes; StarPay-mini, a platform for mini-apps; and StarPay Order, which provides a cashless and cash register-free ordering system. It also provides regional point service; StarPayDigital coupon; payment gateway for overseas financial institutions; and inbound promotion services. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

AVILEN Inc. engages in the AI business in Japan. The company offers customized technical core module products, such as Genea for image generation; Instructea, an LLM product; Findea, for abnormality and damage detection; Cognea for special paper recognition; Autea for automatic operation; Movea for action recognition; Recommea, a recommendation solution; Numerea for numerical analysis; and Estimea for data analysis and forecasting. It also provides form processing AI agents; ChatMee, a secure business use of ChatGPT; LEAD DYNAMICS to automate form sales; and AI Clean Manager, a substituted contamination cleaning supervision product. In addition, the company offers Build up package products, including DX literacy assessment, AI and DX organization development road map, AI engineer training, e-certificate course, deep learning domain specific training, machine learning course, data scientist training, ChatGPT business training, AI business Training, G-certificate preparation course, DS-certification, data utilization training, DX literacy training, and generative AI training lineup. AVILEN Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Chuo, Japan.

Kusurinomadoguchi, Inc. provides solutions for pharmacies and medical care in Japan. The company offers EPARK drug counter, a pharmacy/drugstore search and reservation site; matching site to buy and sell dead stock medicines at dispensing pharmacies; site for medicine counter telephone medical treatment; Care Daisy system to link recording systems and ICT devices; solution for purchasing pharmaceuticals; and system that allows for centralized management of outpatient reception, outpatient reservations, and online medical treatment. It also provides Pharmacy Support, a customer management system for repeat patients in the pharmacy industry; system specialized for dispensing pharmacies; matching service that connects nursing care facilities and pharmacies; solution from the purchase of pharmaceuticals to the purchase of immovable inventory; Online consultation by hospital support; online medication guidance; support solution to pharmacies; EPARK medicine notebook, a medication notebook that allows to make dispensing reservations and manage family medicines; and a system that allows patients to select the pharmacy they want to visit. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Blue Innovation Co., Ltd. provides inspection, disaster prevention, education, and logistics solutions in Japan and internationally. It offers Blue Earth Platform, a software platform that controls and manages drones and robots for various solutions. The company also provides inspection solutions, including drone power line inspection, inspection and surveying, underwater inspection, sewer inspection, and inspection starter pack, as well as inspection outsourcing plan and robot-based automated patrol inspection; and port solutions, such as drone disaster prevention, automated patrol, and port information management system, as well as portable and fixed drone ports. In addition, it offers education and pilot support solutions comprising plant inspection specialist training course, drone flight log creation and information management service, dedicated drone flight support map service, and compensation; and robot cleaning solutions for offices. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

S&J Corporation provides cybersecurity services in Japan. The company operates through SOC service and Consulting Service segments. The company offers security monitoring solutions, including SOC outsourcing, active directory monitoring service, monitoring service for Microsoft 365 E5, professional services for Microsoft 365 E5, My SOC 365 service, Darktrace alert analysis and monitoring service, KeepEye, keepEye RansomSafe, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and Apex One. It also provides security assessment solutions, such as web application diagnostics, API diagnostics, smartphone app diagnostics, platform diagnosis, AWS/Azure/GCP configuration diagnostics, web AI diagnosis, and tack surface management. In addition, the company offers consulting services related to security advisory, security evaluation, security assessment quick assessment, suspicious email training, CSIRT construction and operation support services, and support services for the Ministry of Economy, Trade, and Industry's SCS evaluation system. Further, it offers security measures solutions comprising CrowdStrike, Joe Sandbox, and BlueVoyant. Additionally, the company provides corporate security personnel development course and incident response training service; and incident response, support, and investigation services. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Minato, Japan.

Umenoyado Brewery Co., Ltd. engages in the production, sale, and product development of sake, liqueurs, and assorted beverages in Japan. The company engages in the manufacturing and distribution of alcoholic beverages including Japanese sake and fruit-infused sake liqueurs through the Aragoshi and Umenoyado no Umeshu brands. Umenoyado Brewery Co., Ltd. was founded in 1893 and is based in Katsuragi, Japan.

Kurimoto,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of ductile iron pipes and accessories, valves, and industrial and construction materials in Japan and internationally. It operates through Lifeline Business, Machinery Systems Business, and Industrial Construction Materials Business segments. The company offers ductile iron pipes, valves, reinforced plastic, and disaster prevention products; disaster prevention products; resilient seated gate, butterfly, emergency shut-off, water level control and pressure regulating auto, orifice, float type, air, reversing, spherical, sleeve, slide gate, hot blast, link seal, goggle, and blow off valves; and sewerage, agricultural water, and well pipes. It also provides pit cover plates, brake discs, and power cable protection pipes, as well as automotive related manufacturing equipment; electricity, gas, petroleum, coal, and energy products comprising industrial valves, sound proof and noise reduction products, secondary battery related manufacturing equipment, plant engineering, crushers, pulverizers/mills, classifiers, dryers, calciners/kilns, heat/abrasion-resistant casting products, and fiber reinforced plastic products; mixers, kneaders, reactors, granulators, dryers, solvent recovery, deodoridising, and flue gas treatment equipment; forging and other presses, peripheral devices, bending rolls; and high function casting products. In addition, the company offers separating, conveying, and heat and water-resistant casting products; dredge pumps; sanitary, air conditioning equipment, and converting products; civil engineering material products, and construction materials; winding core pipes; and pharmaceutical equipment. Kurimoto,Ltd. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Kogi Corporation manufactures and sells casting roll-related products, environmental equipment, and friction materials for automobiles, railways, and industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Casting Field, Environment Field/Environmental Engineering, and Environment Field/Functional Materials segments. It offers castings for press dies, TGC 600, industrial machinery related casting, steel related casting; ACE automatic molding machine, V process automatic molding machine, gray cast iron, spheroidal graphite cast iron. In addition, it sells steel sheets, wires, bars used as materials for automotive parts, screws, nails, and other automotive components; H-beams, angle steel, channel steel, and deformed steel bars for construction, as well as slabs, billets, beam blanks. The company also offers dense bar; blower, transvector, and environmental equipment; functional materials; sand casting, and mold casting. Further, it engages in the research and development activities. Kogi Corporation was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Himeji, Japan.

Nippon Chuzo K. K. engages in supplying large, special, and steel castings for construction in Japan. The company also provides steel materials, cast iron, new casting technologies and formed and fabricated materials, and particularly for casting maIt is also involved in Engineering services in relation to bearings and expansion joints; and Construction materials for NC base plates, and buildings and structures products. In addition, it provides space and defense, semiconductor and LCD production, construction machinery, energy systems, waste incineration, industrial presses, iron production, casting systems, mighty bar, hydraulic components. Further, the company provides pivot bearing, pivot roller bearing, pin bearing, pin roller bearing, pot bearing, spherical bearing, line bearing, horizontal bearing, rubber bearings, function-separated bearing, super high-damping rubber bearing, super high-damping rubber bearings for cold climates, horizontal force dispersing rubber bearing, disc rubber bearing, expansion joints, swivel joint, and maurer joint. Additionally, it offers damper units, such as Joining brackets, square to round joints, NC nodes, and joining pins; and construction hardware and landscaping products, including Joining brackets, square to round joints, NC nodes, joining pins, construction materials section, and NC base plate. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.

Nippon Chutetsukan K.K. manufactures and sells ductile iron pipes and lids, polyethylene pipes, and valves primarily in Japan. It provides ductile iron pipes for water supply, sewage, gas, industrial water, and agricultural water; ductile cast iron deformed tubes; ductile iron covers for applications in water supply, sewage, gas, electricity, and telecommunications; polyethylene pipes for gas; valves and plugs; accessories, such as pressure rings, rubber rings, bolts, and nuts; cast iron products; and water supply and on-site pipe laying works. It also engaged in the construction and sales of pipes, water facility construction, engineering, and pipeline deterioration diagnosis.
