In addition, it manufactures and sales products, storage and transportation of gas piping materials, collection, transportation, and transshipment storage of industrial waste, scrap metal, and scrap iron. The company was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Ame Kaze Taiyo, Inc. provides food-related services for individuals in Japan. It operates through Services for Individuals and Services for Businesses segments. The company plans, develops, and operates Pocket Marché, an app that allows users to buy fresh seasonal ingredients, such as fruits, vegetables, fish products, and meat products directly from farmers and fishermen; Taberu Times, a monthly food information magazine; and Pokemaru Hometown Tax, a hometown tax payment platform. It also offers Chihokon!, a marriage consultation service that supports local matchmaking; and STAYJAPAN, a hotel reservation website. In addition, the company plans and implements nature study programs for parents and children; and programs, such as local government support services and corporate food ingredient sales. The company was formerly known as Pocket Marche Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ame Kaze Taiyo, Inc. in April 2022. Ame Kaze Taiyo, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Hanamaki, Japan.

Nyle Inc. provides consulting and marketing services in Japan. It offers DX and digital marketing services, such as SEO consulting, content creation, data analysis, and generative AI generation, as well as outstanding execution services; media solutions, including AppLub, platform service and Appliv Games; and automotive Industry DX solutions, such as car subscription services; and web media that supports car selection and car life information. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

MRSO Inc. engages in the healthcare platform management and vertical SaaS provision to medicals, governments, and corporations in Japan. The company's web reservation system is used to manage reservations for various health checkups and vaccinations conducted by government agencies. It also provides website design services for medical facilities; healthcare BPO services; medical system development services based on MRSO operation; management system for medical facilities; Health Plus medical business support system; and medical tourism services, as well as operates a web media that offers articles on the theme of body and health. MRSO Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Human Technologies, Inc. develops and sells attendance management system. It offers KING OF TIME, a cloud-based attendance management system; DigitalPersona AD MFA, a PC authentication reinforcement system; DigitalPersona AD SSO, a single sign-on system; and Digital Persona SDK, a fingerprint authentication development kit. It also provides services human resources management, and payroll management. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

The Japan Steel Works, Ltd. engages in the provision of industrial machinery products, and material and engineering solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers polyolefin pelletizers, film and sheet manufacturing equipment, and extruders, as well as lifecysle solution such as maintenance concierge, and retrofitting; plastic injection, standard and special purpose injection, magnesium injection, and blow molding machines; and other machinery consists of excimer laser annealing systems, maritime and ground defense equipment, railway products, hot press devices, vacuum laminators, and deposit systems, plastics, mobility, high-performance batteries, coupler and draft gear for rolling stock, gate, overhaul, and electronics, as well as after sale services. It also provides steel casting and forgings, such as reactor and steam generator parts, rotor shafts, turbine casings, die steel, steel rolls for steel mills, and clad steel plates; components for offshore wind power; and steel pressure vessels for hydrogen storage. In addition, the company offers affiliates, vacuum deaeration system, magnet clamp system, mold change molding system, and IoT solutions. Further, the company provides photonics, composite materials, and metallic materials for use in semiconductors and electronic devices, cameras and sensing devices, aircraft and mobility components, and electronic parts. It serves plastic, mobility, batteries, electronic devices, defense, power generation, renewable energy, infrastructure, and photonics business. The Japan Steel Works, Ltd. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Mitsubishi Steel Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells steel products, construction machinery parts, automotive parts, and machinery and equipment in Japan, North America, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. It provides steel products, including structural carbon steel and alloy steels, spring steels, non-heat treated steels, high carbon chromium bearing steels, and others; coil, heavy-duty coil, and leaf springs, stabilizer bars, springs for railway vehicles, and precision parts; as well as special alloy powders, precision castings, machined metal parts, special materials and machined products, and wear-resistant cast steel products. The company also offers forging presses, forging manipulators, ring rolling mills, cold forging presses, magnetic separators, link conveyors, buckets, vibration isolators, scaling systems, other industrial machineries, outer casings for gas turbines, pressure vessels, and steel working products. In addition, it provides research and development services; and sells automotive parts, construction machinery parts, wear resistant teeth for shellfish harvesting, and wood processor tire chains. The company was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Metalart Corporation engages in the manufacture, machining, and sales of hot forged, precise, and closed-die-forged products for automobiles, construction and agricultural machinery, ships, and other industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. It offers engine parts, such as crank shafts, and connecting rods; precision forged gears; CVT products; manual transmission gears; automatic transmission parts; suspension components; sprockets; arm and bucket components; marine engine components; track links; and other parts, as well as chassis parts. The company also provides HV parts, camshafts, and construction machinery related parts; shipping related products, such as cleaning equipment parts and connecting rods; and hanger sockets and axle gears. In addition, it is involved in the manufacture, heat treatment, and surface treatment of precise forged products; manufacture of dies for hot forging and cold forging; and hot press forging, hot hammer forging, and machining. The company was formerly known as Goto Drop Forging Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Metalart Corporation in October 1991. Metalart Corporation was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Kusatsu, Japan.

Nichia Steel Works, Ltd. manufactures and sells wire products in Japan. The company manufactures and sells ordinary and special wire products, including galvanized iron wire, alloy galvanized iron wire, colored coated galvanized iron wire, hard steel wire, piano wire, plated steel wire, galvanized steel wire, alloy galvanized steel wire, rolled flat steel wire, galvanized flat steel wire, colored steel wire, and processed wire products. It also offers spiral wire products, including torsion bolts, GN bolts, and high-strength bolts, as well as wildlife protection fences, barbed wire products, and other civil engineering and construction-related processed products. In addition, the company provides plating processing services, galvanizing and wire processing solutions, product development, technical innovation, customer-specific product design, construction and civil engineering solutions, by-products, and real estate leasing services. The company's products are used in construction, civil engineering, buildings, factories, warehouses, bridges, steel towers, agriculture, wildlife protection, aquaculture, paper manufacturing, and other industrial applications. Nichia Steel Works, Ltd. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells stainless steel wires in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It offers stainless-steel wires, such as spring, micro, cold heading, shaft, weaving, and high alloy/titanium wires for use in vehicles, aircraft, office automation appliances, electric appliances, medical instruments, commodities, and leisure goods, as well as screws, steel nettings, etc. The company also offers filament yarn, cloth, tape, belt, felt, knit, sleeve, chop, and other metal fibers under the NASLON brand name. In addition, it provides filters, such as metal filters, including NASLON filters, NPM filters, EXCEL PORE, FINE MET, and re-washable systems for synthetic fiber, film, resin, nuclear and thermal power generation, petroleum refining, medical, and other applications; and semiconductor gas filters for process and bulk gases, component protection, integrated gas panels, and diffusers. Further, the company offers palladium alloy roll-plated hydrogen separation membrane for high purity hydrogen gas production and purification; high-strength copper-alloy wire for optical pickup and camera module; stainless steel wire for high corrosion resistant and heat resistant springs; hydrogen embrittlement resistant stainless steel spring wire; duplex stainless-steel wire for corrosion resistant springs, ropes, fasteners, wire mesh, etc.; and co-based alloy for medical use. The company was formerly known as The Sanshin Special Wire Manufacturing Company and changed its name to Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. in October 1956. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Daido Steel Co., Ltd.

Sanyu Co., Ltd. produces and sells steel products in Japan. The company offers polished steel bars, including carbon steel for machine construction, sulfur and sulfur-compound free cutting steel, and alloy steel; cold heading steel wires comprising carbon, boron, and alloy steel wires; and cold-rolled steel bars. It also provides bicycle parts, rotating shafts for electrical products; shaft materials for industrial machinery; printing and spinning machines, rail materials for automated equipment; cylinder rods for hydraulic and pneumatic equipment; construction machinery parts, press molds, turbine shafts for hydroelectric and thermal power generators; rotating shafts for pumps and motors; sewing machine parts and furniture; and bolts, nuts, rivets, small screws, tapping screws, and other types of screws, as well as cold-forged parts for automobiles, bicycles, and industrial equipment. Sanyu Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Hirakata, Japan.

Envipro Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the resource recycling, global trading, and lithium-ion battery recycling businesses in Japan and internationally. The company handles, collects, and transports metal scrap and industrial waste, waste materials; produces recycled materials, such as stainless steel, plastics, and rubber; and deals in recycled resources. It also handles import and trilateral trade of natural resources; provides logistics services for import and export businesses; handles process waste materials and used batteries discharged from battery factories to produce rare metals, such as cobalt and nickel; and provides advisory services on environmental management and ESG investment, as well as is involved in the disability welfare service business. Envipro Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Fujinomiya, Japan.

IBOKIN Co.,Ltd. operates as an urban mining development in Japan. The company is involve in the demolition business, such as plant demolition, wind power generation equipment dismantling, crane dismantling, building and structure demolition, equipment and machinery removed, asbestos removal work, special disintegration, and large heavy equipment dismantling; environmental business, including plastic, wood, office equipment, medical equipment, medical equipment, and FRP boat recycling, as well as mixed waste, metal composites, fluorocarbon recovery, and disaster waste. It also engages in metals business comprising steel recycling, non-ferrous metal recycling, and automobile recycling. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Tatsuno-shi, Japan.

Daiki Aluminium Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, markets, and sells aluminium alloy products in Japan and internationally. The company offers aluminium alloys for die casting and casting, molten aluminium alloys, energy-saving small ingots, and electrical parts and frames for automobiles and motorcycles, and precision equipment; wrought aluminium alloys for beverage cans, sashes for building materials, and other products, as well as raw materials for alloys; and steel auxiliary materials for steel, as well as magnesium chloride. It also wholesales aluminium raw materials to aluminium alloy manufacturers and trading companies; recycles metals; and sells melting and holding furnaces, as well as provides technical support to its customers. The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

long_name: Nippon Light Metal Holdings Company, Ltd.
business_summary: Nippon Light Metal Holdings Company, Ltd. manufactures and sells aluminum products and related products in Japan and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Alumina, Chemical products, Bullion; Plate, Extruded products; Processed products and related businesses; and Foil and Powder Products Business. It develops and manufactures various chemicals, including alumina and aluminum hydroxide, as well as aluminum alloys; aluminum sheet metal and extruded aluminum profiles, and supplies to various fields. The company also develops and manufactures aluminum foil, powder, and paste products; and develops, manufactures, and supply products for various fields, including automobiles, truck bodies, railways, building materials, food products, and cleanrooms. Nippon Light Metal Holdings Company, Ltd. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

JMC Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of prototypes, parts, and products using advanced 3D printing, sand casting, and industrial computed tomography (CT) technologies in Japan. The company also offers inspection/measurement services of CT for industrial use, as well as sells industrial CT scanners. The company serves customers across various industries, including wholesale, precision machinery and medical equipment manufacturing, electric machinery, general machinery, transportation machinery, steel and non-ferrous metals, metal products, automotive maintenance, entertainment, professional services, education, and research institutes. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Mitsui Kinzoku Company, Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells functional engineered and electronic materials in Japan, China, India, Asia, North America, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Functional Materials Business, Metals Business, Automotive Parts Business, and Other Businesses. The company offers copper foil with carrier film, resin-coated copper foil, electro-deposited copper foil, and material of capacitors; catalysts; tin and zinc oxide, copper, silver, and solder powders, as well as power metallurgy; hydrogen storage alloy and lithium manganese oxide; tantalumu, niobium oxides, and carbides, as well as cerium oxide abrasives; oxides/rare earth compounds, metal products, and rare earth salts/ceramics; alumina and silicon carbide refractories, fine ceramics, and metalofilter; sputtering targets; engineered liquids; debondable glass carrier materials; and negative thermal expansion materials and LNMO cathodes. It also provides zinc and zinc base alloys; chemical products; lead, tin, bismuth, and antimony trioxide; gold and silver ingots and powders, concentrated and fuming sulfuric acid, and electric copper, copper ingots, and wire rods; and mineral and geothermal resources, as well as mineral resources development and environmental protection engineering services. In addition, the company engages in corrosion prevention; engineering; mechatronics; perlite; information technology systems; and rolled copper businesses. Further, it is involved in nonferrous metal smelting; precious metal recycling; raw material related businesses; and manufacturing and sale of automotive parts/components. The company was formerly known as Mitsui Mining & Smelting Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsui Kinzoku Company, Limited in October 2025. Mitsui Kinzoku Company, Limited was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Toho Zinc Co., Ltd. operates in the smelting and refining, mineral resources, electronic components, advanced materials, and environment and recycling businesses in Japan. The company offers electrolytic zinc, die-casting zinc alloys, zinc powder, cadmium oxide, sulfuric acid, electrolytic lead, lead alloys, and electrolytic silver and bismuth. It also operates zinc and lead mines; and produces iron, ferrite, amorphous powders, and Fe-Al-Si based powder core materials for use in automotive electronics, office automation equipment, and industrial equipment. In addition, the company provides MAIRON and ATOMIRON electrolytic irons, as well as produces recycled zinc oxide from electric furnace dust. Toho Zinc Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Mitsubishi Materials Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in smelting and sale of copper, gold, silver, lead, tin, palladium, and other metals. The company also offers resources circulation; manufactures and sells copper and copper alloy products; and tungsten. In addition, it is involved in the manufacture and sale of cemented carbide products and related metalworking solutions, and advanced products; geothermal, hydroelectric, and solar power generation; and investment in and participation in mining projects. Further, the company recovers and recycles valuable metals from discarded home appliances and automobile products; offers copper alloy products; and electronic materials and components for semiconductors, automotive applications (xEVs), healthcare, and electronic devices. Additionally, it engages in geothermal, hydroelectric, and solar energy business; and engineering, maintenance, industrial machinery and equipment, and resource and environmental consulting. It has operations in Japan, America, Europe, Asia, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company was founded in 1871 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the resource development, manufacture, and sale of non-ferrous metal products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Mineral Resources, Smelting and Refining, and Material segments. The company is involved in the development and operation of the Hishikari Mine and other mines; smelting and refining business, which provides metal products, such as copper, nickel and cobalt, silver, platinum, rhodium, ruthenium, palladium, slag sand, copper sulfate, selenium, gypsum, sulfuric acid, and green sand, as well as gold and precious metals, rolled copper foil, copper and brass strips, tin plated copper and brass strips, and iron contained pellets; and develops and produces battery materials. It also produces battery cathode material for vehicles; lithium tantalate and lithium niobate for communication devices; cesium tungsten oxide, other near infrared ray absorbing materials, and thick film pastes; copper-clad polyimide films and printed wiring boards; silicon-carbide semiconductor; and automobile exhaust gas purification catalysts, chemical catalysts, and hydrotreating catalysts. In addition, the company engages in the water and precious metals recycling; water treatment and environmental improvement operations; and environmental preservation; sterilization, disinfection, and polymer material modification services for medical devices, non-woven fabrics and hygienic materials, laboratory and clinical testing equipment, containers, food packaging materials, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and herbal medicine materials. Further, it is involved in the coastal shipping, port transport, in-plant logistics, and land transportation. The company was formerly known as Seika Kogyo (Mining) Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd. in June 1952. Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd. was founded in 1590 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Dowa Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the environmental management and recycling, nonferrous metals, electronic materials, metal processing, and heat treatment businesses. The company offers Incineration of industrial waste; landfilling of waste; melting and recycling of incinerated ash; surveys and remediation of soil; environmental consulting; recycling of metal and discarded household appliances; and treatment of automotive shredder dust services. It also provides gold, silver, copper, lead, tin, antimony, nickel sulfate, zinc, zinc alloys, indium, and sulfuric acid metals; recycling of platinum-group metals; and resource and raw material procurement services. In addition, the company offers high-purity materials, gallium arsenide wafers, infrared LEDs, and ultraviolet LEDs; electronic materials, including silver, copper, and conductive atomized powder; advanced fine materials, such as magnetic, carrier, ferrite, and compound oxide powder; and copper alloy strips, nickel alloy strips, reflow tin-plated strips, and forged brass products, as well as metal-ceramics substrates. Further, it provides precious metal electroplating services; design, manufacture, marketing and maintenance of heat treatment facilities; and heat and surface treatment services. The company was formerly known as Dowa Mining Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dowa Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2006. Dowa Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1884 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Furukawa Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells machinery, metals, electronics, and chemical products Japan and internationally. It operates through Industrial Machinery, Rock Drills, Unique, Metals, Electronics, Chemical Products, and Real Estate segments. The company offers slurry, sewage, submersible heavy-duty sand, water, special, and shield construction slurry pumps; crushers, grinding mills, briquetting machines, classifiers and separators, scrap car shredders, crushers and mills for recycling use, material handling systems, and plants; and electrostatic precipitators, filtration-type precipitators, electric precipitators for tunneling work, harmful gas processors, water treatment equipment, and steel structures and bridge. It also provides hydraulic breakers, crushers, and crawler drills; pneumatic crawler, down the hole drills, and rotary drills; tunnel and mining machines; concrete sprayers; pneumatic tools; UNIC cranes and carriers; mini crawler, and marine and ocean cranes. In addition, the company offers electrolytic copper, gold, and silver; sulfuric acid; metallic arsenic, crystal products, calcogenide compounds, cores and coils, aluminum nitride ceramics, optical components, and diffractive-optical elements; ferric polysulfate solution, aluminum sulfate, cuprous and copper oxide, copper carbonate, Iron sulfate heptahydrate and titanium dioxide and other related products. Further, it provides global and domestic transportation; storage in warehouse service; tin, aluminum, silicon, magnesium, and copper powder; castings erosion-resistant cast steels; and manganese and chromium steel, reinforcement, and alloy and wear-resistant castings. The company was formerly known as Furukawa Mining Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Furukawa Co.,Ltd. in 1989. Furukawa Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

S Crypto Energy Inc. engages in crypto asset, metal, and real estate business in Japan. The company operates through six segments: Nickel Business, Real Estate Business, Education Business, Smart DX Solutions Business, Crypto Asset Business, and Other. The company's products include S pellets anodes, nickel balls anode, plating nickel chips, nickel sulfate, nickel chloride, and P pellets and anodes. It is also involved in treasury business, advisory services, and grid business, as well as development of real estate projects. The company was formerly known as S Science Company, Ltd. and changed its name to S Crypto Energy Inc. in April 2026. S Crypto Energy Inc. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Asaka Riken Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the precious metal, environmental, and other businesses in Japan. It collects precious metals, such as gold, silver, and white gold from circuit board scraps, defective products, and waste products; provides peeling, surface treatment, and precision cleaning of the film forming equipment; and recovers valuable metals from dentistry scrap. The company also collects and recycles waste solutions of ferric chloride. In addition, it offers filter materials for purified water, as well as designs/constructs filter systems; and develops, manufactures, and sells photocatalyst materials for environmental purification. Further, the company develops and sells measurement software systems and automatic measuring systems, as well as transportation of industrial waste, industrial chemicals, scraps, and other waste. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Koriyama, Japan.

OSAKA Titanium technologies Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells titanium products in Japan, the United States of America, China, and internationally. The company offers titanium sponges, titanium ingots, titanium tetrachloride, titanium tetrachloride aqueous solutions, and ferro-titanium products; and high-performance materials, including titanium powder, high-purity titanium, silicon monoxide, as well as gas-atomized titanium powder. Its products are used daily necessities such as aircraft and automobiles that feature functionality and lightweight structures; LNG plants which produce liquid natural gas which are low carbon clean energy; seawater desalination plants that needs are expanding globally to solve water resource issues; semiconductors that support the electronics industry; digital home appliances that is used in every aspect of daily lives; and leisure and sporting goods industries. In addition, the company produces and develops high-performance materials. The company was formerly known as Sumitomo Titanium Corporation and changed its name to OSAKA Titanium technologies Co.,Ltd. in 2007. OSAKA Titanium technologies Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells antimony products and metal powders in Japan. It offers antimony trioxide, which is used as a flame-retardant additive for various plastic material and polyester polymerization catalysts. The company also provides antimony metal for use in raw materials for semiconductors, batteries, bearing friction reduction, hard lead castings, electric wires, cables, typefaces, lead pipes, and other alloys; antimony metal powder for glass clarifying agents and alloys; and antimony metal shots for alloys. In addition, it offers special treatment antimony trioxide; sodium antimonate for use in engineering plastics, and defoaming agent and decolorizing agent for high-grade glass such as optical glass; antimony trisulfide for use in friction material in brake pads and brake shoes; and antimony pentasulfide used as a surface finish with a sense of weight and durability for entrances and elevator doors of shrines, temples, western-style buildings, and public facilities. Further, the company provides antimony trichloride and antimony pentachloride for use as catalysts in fluorination, chlorination, and bromination of organic compounds, pigments, and semiconductor materials; SULMICS series, provides various metal sulfides such as tin sulfide and SULMICS-121; and STEM series a composite flame retardant that does not contain halogens or antimony and is available in magnesium hydroxide-based and phosphorus-based types, such as PP and PE. Additionally, it manufactures and sells atomized metal powders of copper, iron alloys, copper alloys, and silver. The company was formerly known as Nakase Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. in 1936. Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

UACJ Corporation manufactures and sells aluminum products in Japan and internationally. The company offers flat rolled products, including aluminum alloy sheets for beverage containers, closures, automobiles sheets, railway rolling stocks, large ship tanks, aluminum alloy quenched sheets for aircraft, and aluminum alloy thick plates; high-conductivity materials for aluminum busbars and highly adhesive surface-treated aluminum alloy sheets; aluminum brazing sheets; EV battery housing, aluminum alloys for lithium-ion battery housing cases, current collectors, and sealing materials; bright aluminum alloy sheets; aluminum checkered plates; and lithographic sheets. It also provides aluminum pipe with irregular-shaped cross section; fitting technology; wear-resistant alloys; alloy for alumite processing; ultraprecision extruded multi-hole aluminum tubes; extruded clad materials; high-temperature strength and creep-resistant alloys; and environment-friendly and free-cutting aluminum alloys. In addition, it offers printed and coated foils, and bonded foils; compressor wheel casting, heat sinks, and precision machined aluminum products; aluminum forged products for aerospace applications, and axle bearing housing for bullet trains; and automotive parts, heat exchangers, plant equipment, and other parts and materials for the industrial sector. The company was formerly known as Furukawa-Sky Aluminum Corp. UACJ Corporation was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

NIC Autotec, Inc. manufacture and sells aluminum frame and FA equipment in Japan and internationally. It offers alpha frame system; alpha clean system; aluminum stand for small robots; alpha guard safety fence; alpha kit, aquarium stands, and server racks; and cup-type washing machine/blow machine. The company also provides FA equipment, including washing machines for batch type and individual cleaning; conveyors comprising automatic cartoners, palletizing stackers, free-flow conveyors, and other various conveyors; screening inspection equipment for dimensions, tap failure, running torque, etc.; and cleanroom products. It serves FA equipment for use in machine processing plants, semiconductor and electronic components plants, and pharmaceutical and food factories. The company was formerly known as Nishikawa Seiki Inc. and changed its name to NIC Autotec, Inc. in April 1985. NIC Autotec, Inc. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

Nippon Shindo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of copper and brass rods, forgings, and other products. The company offers brass rods and wires, as well as brass alloys. Its products are used in gas equipment, plumbing products, and air conditioners in the housing industry; screws, bolts, and nuts in the auto industry; and connectors for personal computers and audio equipment in the electronics industry. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of brass rod and wire products in Japan, China, and Taiwan. It operates through Copper extension, Precision parts, and Piping and Plating segments. The company also offers brass tubes; camera mounts and synchro rings; iron pipe fittings for residential use; and piping equipment under the CK brand; precision parts through forging and machining activities; and hot-dip galvanized products. It serves copper alloys, precision parts, piping, mirrors, gold, and related industries. The company was formerly known as SAN-ETSU METALS Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. in October 2011. CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is based in Takaoka, Japan.

MAEZAWA Holdings CO.,LTD., through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of water supply and sewage-related products. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd. provides a wide range of products in the business fields of Optical Solutions, Digital Infrastructure Components, Energy Infrastructure, Automotive Systems and Metal Solutions worldwide. It operates through Infrastructure; Electrical and Electronic; Functional Products; and Services and Developments segments. The company offers optical fiber/optical active components, optical fiber cable, optical closure/optical termination box, optical connector and cord, optical fiber identifier, fusion splicer/optical connecting tool,  broadband system, router/network equipment, industrial infrastructure systems, and wireless products; tape for semiconductor process, cable conduit materials, heat insulator, fluorescent lamp and LED reflectors, polyethylene pipe, heat dissipation/cooling products, aluminum blank material for hard disk drives, copper foil, and optical devices and components; and power cable, cable-related equipment/connection and terminal products, industrial machine-related equipment, power distribution products, metal communication cable, wiring materials, fire prevention products, and submarine water pipe. It also provides wire harness, sliding door harness, BUS harness, corrosion-proof terminal for aluminum wire, connector for automobile, steering roll connector, metal core printed-circuit-board, and lead battery status detection sensor; copper alloy wire/oxygen-free copper wire, insulated and special wires, copper and copper alloy products, plating, and superconducting cable; as well as insulated lasers, infrastructure maintenance, optical medical device development platform, optical fiber probe, optical fiber sensor for diagnostic applications, and detection solutions for internal medical devices. Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd. was founded in 1884 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd. manufactures and sells various materials in Japan and internationally. It operates in Environment and Energy, Infocommunications, Automotive, Electronics, and Industrial Materials and Others segments. It offers vanadium redox flow battery, high voltage cable, sEMSA, industrial electric wires and cables, traveling cable, railway and transport machinery products, aluminum materials, heat shrink tubing and heat-resistant tubing/tapes, thermal control devices, and water treatment membrane; and fiber optic, fusion splicer and accessories, data center solutions, remote monitoring of FTTx distribution line, NanoPlug, CATV systems, set top box, optical and wireless devices, AirMT, non-contact multi-fiber interconnect, and low profile fiber-array. The company also provides electric wires and cables for automobiles, components for wiring harnesses, electronics, HVs and EVs, pedestrian radar, steel cords for tire reinforcement, steel wires for springs, abrasion-resistant parts, magnet wires, sintered ZnS lenses, wiring materials/electronics, sintered components, copper-diamond/molybdenum/ tungsten, chemical vapor deposition-diamond, single crystal, magnesium-silicon carbide, diamond/CBN cutting tool, dies wire drawing tool, and dresser, and aluminum nitride. In addition, it offers electronic wires, flexible printed circuit, heat-shrinkable tubing, nickel alloy/cladded/plated wire, metal foam/electroplated wire, POREFLON PTFE membrane, the cross linked fluorine resin FEX, spiral shielded wires, coaxial cables, flat components, thunderbolt and USB4 cables, plated and alloy wires, and RGB laser modules; and PC steel wires, drills/endmills, CBN/PCD, milling and turning tools, and laser optics. The company was formerly known as Sumitomo Electric Wire & Cable Works and changed its name to Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd. in January 1939. Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd. was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Fujikura Ltd. engages in telecommunication and power systems, electronic, and automotive products businesses in Japan, the rest of Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company operates in five segments: Telecommunication Systems Business Division, Electronics Business Division, Automotive Products Business Division, Power Systems Business Division, and Real Estate Business Division. The Telecommunication Systems Business Division segment offers optical fibers, optical fiber cables, telecommunication components, optical components, fiber optic equipment, and network equipment, as well as related installation services. The Electronics Business Division segment provides flexible printed circuits, electronic wiring, HDD components, and various connectors. The Automotive Products Business Division segment offers automotive wire harnesses, and accessories, as well as related installation services. The Power Systems Business Division segment provides power cables, telecommunication cables, aluminum wires, and enameled wires. The Real Estate Business Division segment engages in the rental of real estate properties. The company was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

SWCC Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of energy, infrastructure, and communication components in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Energy & Infrastructure Business and Telecommunications & Components Business segments. It offers electric wires, electric cables, power equipment, engineering, aluminum wires, equipment and electrical materials, seismic isolation devices, and vibration control/damping; communications cables, optical products, equipment wires, wire harnesses, precision devices, windings, bare wires, oxygen-free copper, copper alloy wires, automotive wires, and wire processing products, as well as engages in the business of transportation, logistics, and other businesses. The company was formerly known as SWCC Showa Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SWCC Corporation in April 2023. SWCC Corporation was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.

Onamba Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells general-purpose wires, communication cables, consumer electronic equipment, information office equipment, and industrial electronic equipment in Japan, rest of Asia, Europe, and America. It offers wires and cables for machine internal; coaxial cables; cables for solar power generation, fixed, and moving applications; environmentally friendly cables; and harnesses for automobile, industrial equipment, and consumer products. The company also provides renewable energy resources products, including PVU-Finder, a solar power generation intelligent monitoring and control system; and E&E-Solution, a self-consumption integrated system. In addition, it offers junction boxes and cables for solar power generation systems, as well as branch boxes/extension and crossing cables; connectors for automobiles; and harness processing equipment and machinery. Onamba Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

JMACS Japan Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells instrumentation cables, control cables, communication cables, disaster prevention cables, optical fiber cables products in Japan. It offers field bus cables, optical cables, offshore wind power generation cables, traffic signal and control cables, and eco-material products; and electric wires. JMACS Japan Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Nihon Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JMACS Japan Co., Ltd. in September 2015. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Kato, Japan.

Canare Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells broadcasting and communication cables, harnesses, connectors, equipment, and related accessories in Japan, the United States, South Korea, China, Taiwan, Singapore, India, Europe, the Middle East, and internationally. It offers optical transmission systems, connectors, cables, connection cables, patch and connector panels, multi-cable systems, cable reels, tools, other transmission devices, open price items, and high-power optical fiber related products, as well as AV and console solutions and digital network products. The company exports its products. It sells its products to broadcasting stations, communication companies, equipment construction companies, broadcasting and communication equipment manufacturers, and others. Canare Electric Co., Ltd. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Nisshin, Japan.

GO Inc. designs and develops a taxi-hailing application that enables users to arrange and schedule a cab ride in Japan. The company's application offers real-time location information sharing, digitalization of operations for taxi companies, management service, and decarbonization services. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Minato, Japan.

Mitsuboshi Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electric wires and synthetic resin products in Japan. The company offers electric wires, such as rubber flexible cables, welding cables, vinyl flexible cables, Star MIC cable series, flexible cords, and high-performance tubes, including thermoflon, blacktrack, rumflon series, transformer master series, popurex series tubes that are applied in physical and chemical equipment, analytical equipment, semiconductor processing, electronic industry, food machinery, general industry, and other applications. It also provides heating wires used in home appliances, industrial and food furnaces, fittings, heaters, hair dryers, industrial equipment, industrial robots and automotive applications. In addition, the company develops and sells energy-saving products, including Retro fit LED Lamps for creation, conservation, and storage of energy. The company was formerly known as Mitsuboshi Trading Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsuboshi Co., Ltd. in 1971. Mitsuboshi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. manufactures and sells cable and assemblies, electric and electronic equipment, and medical equipment and parts in Japan and internationally. The company offers semi-flexible coaxial cords and semi-rigid coaxial cords for internal wiring and connection of high-frequency equipment; high speed cables; super-fine coaxial cables for medical precision equipment; interface cables for digital signals, including industry-certified products; factory automation cables; broadcast cables and optical fibercables; insulated wires and shield insulated wires for internal wiring of various electrical and electronic devices; power cords and power supply components; tubes; harness for internal wiring materials for multimedia-related industrial equipment and connection wires between equipment; and other products. It also provides optical converters, network equipment, optical camera modules, and AC normal charger for EV/PHEV. In addition, the company engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of special medical tubing, as well as related processed goods used in medical, analysis equipment, and other special industrial fields; design, execution, and management and contract work of electrical and telecommunications work; and leasing and management of real estate. Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. was formerly known as Hirakawa Electric Wire Corporation and changed its name to Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. in October 1990. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Iyogin Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking products and services in Japan. It operates in two segments, Banking and Leasing. The company offers deposit, lending, securities investment, foreign exchange, banking outsourcing, credit guarantee, credit card, and investment fund management services. It also engages in the leasing of office equipment, industrial machinery, machine tools, medical equipment, and others; automotive maintenance lease; and installment payment sales contracts and loans. In addition, the company is involved in information processing outsourcing, software development and sale, and office automation equipment sale; mortgage and consumer loan debt guarantees; cash management and verification work, as well as ATM maintenance management work; and investment activities in stocks and corporate bonds, as well as management and administration of investment partnership assets. Further, it engages in business consulting, industry survey, contract research, and publication; warranty services; intermediation, brokerage, and agency services for the buying and selling of securities; printing and binding services for documents and other forms; manufacturing and sale of wood products, textiles, and office supplies; and debt management and collection services, as well as debt purchase services. The company was formerly known as The Iyo Bank, Ltd. and changed its name to Iyogin Holdings, Inc. in October 2022. Iyogin Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1878 and is headquartered in Matsuyama, Japan.

Shizuoka Financial Group,Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services. It operates through Banking Operations and Leasing Operations segments. The company engages in the banking business centered on deposits, loans, investment securities, and exchange transactions. It is also involved in the lease transactions centered on finance leases. In addition, the company provides management consulting and payment collection; human resources and general affairs related tasks, valuation and investigation services for real estate secured by manufacturing contracts, etc; processing of money orders, collections; computer-related services, computational outsourcing services; credit card services, credit guarantee services; document creation, printing, and binding services. Further, the company engages in the marketing support services, advertising agency duties, textile and drug introduction fees; and consulting firm specializing in providing financial support and assistance to real estate investment funds. The company was formerly known as The Shizuoka Bank, Ltd. Shizuoka Financial Group,Inc. was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.

Chugin Financial Group,Inc. provides banking services in Japan. It operates through Banking, Leasing, and Securities segments. The Banking segment offers financial services, such as deposit taking and lending services. The Leasing segment engages in leasing and installment sales of properties and goods. The Securities segment offers brokerage services for financial instruments. Chugin Financial Group,Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

SBI Leasing Services Co., Ltd. engages in the arrangement and selling of investment funds in the operating lease business primarily focused on aircraft and ships. It operates through three segments: Fund Business, General Aviation Business, and Principal Investment Business. It engages in financial services, investment, asset management, crypto-assets, and next gen business. The company offers securities, banking, and insurance; asset management related services; fund management in multiple areas, including venture capital, leveraged buyout, and business succession; exchange and trading services relating to digital assets; and business activities relating to biotechnology, healthcare and medical informatics, web 3, and new overseas markets. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Minato, Japan. SBI Leasing Services Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of SBI Holdings, Inc.

Rakuten Bank, Ltd. provides internet banking products and services to individual, corporate, and sole proprietor customers in Japan. Its deposit products include fixed-term, foreign currency, and yen deposits; securities; and investment trusts. The company also offers card loans, securities-backed loans, real estate secured loans, reverse mortgages, educational loans, home loan, and insurance products. In addition, it provides deposit, withdrawal, payment, transfer and remittance, and receive services; debit, credit, and cash card; international money transfer; and account and ID management, cashless, and partner services. Rakuten Bank, Ltd. has strategic alliance with Mizuho Bank, Ltd. to establishing a credit creation model. Rakuten Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nippon Insure Co., Ltd. provides rent guarantee for rental housing services in Japan. The company operates through the Guarantee Business and Other segments. It also offers rent guarantee services for rental stores and offices, as well as expense guarantee for nursing care and hospitalization expenses. In addition, the company operates coin laundry stores under the WASH House brand and fitness centers for women under the Curves brand. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan. Nippon Insure Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Miyoshi Real Estate Co., Ltd.

Kyoto Financial Group,Inc., through its subsidiary, provides various banking products and services in Japan. It accepts current, ordinary, savings, time, and other deposits, as well as deposits at notice and negotiable certificates of deposit; and offers loans and overdrafts. The company also engages in trading of commodity securities, securities investment, domestic foreign exchange, and foreign exchange, as well as securities services, credit guarantees, leasing, and credit cards. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

Zenhoren Co.,Ltd. provides rent guarantee services to lessors of rental properties in Japan. It offers rent guarantee services for residential buildings, stores and offices, parking lots, warehouses and trunk rooms, and fire insurance and real estate companies, as well as tuition fee guarantee services for vocational schools and students through Z-College support. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Naha, Japan. As of April 3, 2025, Zenhoren Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsubishi UFJ NICOS Co.,Ltd.

LiNKX, Inc. operates as a financial technology company in Japan. The company specializes in modernization and reconstruction through cloud-based and AI-based technologies. It offers design and implementation methods to support the development of systems such as accounting systems, API gateways, and data infrastructure for the financial sector, including banks. Its products include LabHub, a platform which supports productivity improvement for researchers, including pharmaceutical companies; and shikAI, a navigation system for the visually impaired, as a social contribution project. The company was formerly known as Links Co., Ltd. and changed its name to LiNKX, Inc. in November 2025. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Ryobi Limited operates as a die casting manufacturer in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. It operates through Die Castings Business, Housing Equipment Business, and Printing Equipment Business segments. The company offers die-cast auto parts, including cylinder blocks, transmission cases, subframes and other chassis parts, and electric car parts; and builder hardware products, including door closers, floor hinges, hardware products, and automatic door operators. It also provides printing equipment, such as offset printing presses and automated printing operations via smart assist printing. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

Ahresty Corporation engages in the aluminum die casting and alloy ingots in Japan. The company offers engine blocks and transmission cases; pedestal heads/caps; metal mold casting products; free access floor panels; and peripheral equipment for die cast machine. It also provides products for electric vehicles and fuel cell vehicles. The company was formerly known as Fuso Light Alloys Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ahresty Corporation in 1988. Ahresty Corporation was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ARE Holdings, Inc. engages in refining, manufacturing, and trading of precious metals and rare metals in Japan, Asia, and North America. The company operates in two segments, Precious Metals and Environmental Preservation. It recycles and sells various metals, including gold, silver, palladium, platinum, and rhodium that are used in a range of industry fields, such as E-scrap, dentistry, jewelry, plating treatment, precision cleaning, and catalysts. The company also engages in the collection, transportation, and intermediate processing of industrial waste, as well as provides digital platform to streamline operations for industrial waste management companies. In addition, it is involved in refining and processing of gold and silver. The company was formerly known as Asahi Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to ARE Holdings, Inc. in June 2023. ARE Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

STG Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture of magnesium and aluminum die casting products in Japan and internationally. It also offers magnesium molded product finishing equipment. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Yao, Japan.

Rococo Co. Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various information technology solutions in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments, ITO & BPO Business and Cloud Solution Business. The company offers ServiceNow, a business application that integrates internal process; IT outsourcing services, including operation/maintenance support, PC-LCM, device set-up services, building IT infrastructure, and cloud IT asset management; and business process outsourcing services, such as help desk and customer center. It also provides facial recognition systems comprising AUTH thru, a facial recognition access control system; AUTH thru KEY, a facial recognition access control system and electric lock; AUTH BrAC, a facial recognition alcohol check; and Work-Reco, a facial recognition worker record. In addition, the company offers ticketing and management support services, which includes tike-uke, a ticketing system; tike-loto, a ticket lottery/seating system; ticket data management; Re-tass LIVE for one-to-one streaming services; and METAWORKS, an automatic typesetting software. Further, it provides Microsoft power platform and system/application development services; and employee attendance mamagement services, such as RocoTime, an employee attendance management system and RocoTimexAUTH, a facial recognition system for clocking in and out. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Nalnet Communications Inc. engages in the automotive-related business process outsourcing (BPO) business in Japan. The company offers inspections, vehicle inspections, repairs, and maintenance for corporate leasing service providers and general corporations; and maintenance management services for leased vehicles to providers of personal leasing services. It is also involved in the provision of data management and tax payment management services; managing the storage and maintenance of tires; undertaking the maintenance and servicing of used cars before delivered to the customer; and other businesses. In addition, the company engages in car leasing; purchase various vehicles, including leased vehicles, company cars, and personal vehicles; and provides residual value guarantee services. Nalnet Communications Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Kasugai, Japan.

SOLIZE Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides digital engineering services in Japan, North America, China, India, Thailand, Europe, and internationally. It operates through the Engineering and Manufacturing, and Consulting and Engineering segments. The company engages in digital engineering development support services, including 3D digital tools, styling, design, analysis, XR, and AI; 3D printer parts manufacturing, such as online 3D printing, 3D printer prototype and final product production, and research and development support; 3D printer sales and maintenance; and transformation consulting services for car, energy infrastructure, construction/general contractor, and LCA. It also provides AI comprising SpectA KY-tool, RFQ guide view, and DKM, as well as mathematics and data scientist-type generative AI agent development services; SDV, which includes MBD/MBSE, autonomous driving, and thermal management; cybersecurity and digital forensics; software development services for embedded control and business systems; educational services, such as private after-school care management, after-school care management consulting, after-school care staff training, and human resource development; and business solutions/DX support. SOLIZE Holdings Corporation was formerly known as SOLIZE Corporation and changed its name to SOLIZE Holdings Corporation in July 2025. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

KURADASHI.Co.,Ltd. engages in the management of social good market under the Kuradashi brand in Japan. The company sells products online, as well as through stores and pop-up shops. KURADASHI.Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

GDEP ADVANCE,Inc. engages in the system incubation business in Japan. The company distributes accelerator products, including NVIDIA graphics and computing boards, and XILINX FPGA boards; AI and GPU workstation products; Infiniband network products; servers, such as PCIe GPU, NVIDIA HGX and DGX, ARM-based GPU, and AMD INSTINCT servers; high-end storage products comprising NetApp unified data storage and DDN A3I solution; and file server and NAS QNAP storage products. It also sells software tools comprising Weights & Biases, an experimental management tool for model research; Altair Grid Engine, a distributed resource management system that provides job scheduling, resource management, and other functions; and Altair PBS Professional, a job scheduling software. In addition, the company offers NVIDIA AI Enterprise and NVIDIA Omniverse solutions; cloud rental services; and DX, subscription, implementation and operation support, hardware maintenance, continuous development environment update, support inquiries, maintenance parts stock, dispatch maintenance, performance benchmarks, and private lecture services. Further, it provides AI solutions; visualization solutions for XR and metaverse; storage solutions for big data; and construction and operation system based on customer requests. GDEP ADVANCE,Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

Japan Eyewear Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, plans, designs, manufactures, and sells eyeglasses in Japan. It sells its products under the Kaneko Optical and Four Nines brand names. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Sabae, Japan.

SAKIGAKE Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the restaurant management business in Japan. The company also provides store management and franchise chain development services. The company was formerly known as Kairikiya Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SAKIGAKE Holdings Co.,Ltd. in July 2026. SAKIGAKE Holdings Co.,Ltd was Incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

yutori, Inc. engages in the planning, retail, and wholesale of clothing and cosmetic products in Japan and internationally. It offers its products under 9090, centimeter, MySugarBabe, YoungerSong, PAMM, BALLSY.BROTHERS, BADWAY, WudgeBoy, nemne, HTH, BrokenBase, BLESSU, Camphorwood, F-LAGSTUF-F, GULL, GOAT ESSENCE, HIROKI TSUZUKI, MARITHE +, codegraphy, shesame, minum, Her lip to, ROSIER by Herlipto and overprint brand names primarily through e-commerce sites. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Daiken Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and supply of various metal products primarily in Japan. The company offers various building materials, including RS visor, clipped type louver, bolted type louver, grating, s-mat; door hardware/hanger rail, slidex, interior door hanger, and door hanger; hatch, including ceiling, floor, wall, and home floor; outdoor shed; and other products, bike rack, multi stocker, curtain rail, and HACCP. It also exports products related to houses and buildings. Daiken Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Toyo Seikan Group Holdings, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells packaging containers in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Packaging; Engineering, Filling and Logistics; Steel Plate Related; Functional Materials Related; Real Estate Related; and Other Businesses segments. The company offers various packaging containers, including metal cans and caps; PET and plastic bottles, plastic films and pouches, and plastic trays and caps; paper cups and corrugated cardboard products; and glass bottles and paper and resin tableware. It also provides steel plate related products, such as materials for metal cans, electrical and electronic components, automotive and industrial machinery parts, construction materials, and consumer electronics; and functional materials comprising magnetic disk aluminum substrates, optical functional films, pigments, enamelware glazes, gel coats, and micro-element fertilizers, as well as tin and thin plates, surface-treated steel sheets, steel bands, automatic binders, synthetic resins, and frit products. In addition, the company offers can and can end making machinery and beverage filling equipment; contract filling and sale of beverages, aerosol, and general liquid-filled products; trucking, warehousing, real estate rental management, and tourism services; and office buildings and commercial properties leasing services. Further, it is involved in the manufacturing and sale of automotive press dies, machinery and appliances, hard alloys, and agricultural-use materials; sale of petroleum products; and non-life insurance agency business. The company was formerly known as Toyo Seikan Kaisha, Ltd. and changed its name to Toyo Seikan Group Holdings, Ltd. in March 2013. Toyo Seikan Group Holdings, Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Hokkan Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the container, filling, and machinery production, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells various types of unfilled cans, containers, tinplate processed products, and die pressing product, as well as PET plastic bottles, containers and bag-in-box, food cans, beverage cans, 18-liter cans, and decorative cans; printing/painting and painting of tin sheets; and molds and processes synthetic resins. It is also involved in the toll manufacturing and sales of soft drinks and alcoholic beverages, various types of other beverages, dairy products and confectionaries, retort pouch food, and agricultural products; and sales of packaging materials. In addition, the company produces, installs, and sales of various types of machinery and equipment; designing, contracted construction, repairs, and maintenance of various types of machinery and equipment; designing and contracted work related to civil engineering, construction, and steel structure work; and construction assistance and civil engineering work services. Further, it engages in consulting business; management, sales, and purchase of securities, money loans, and guarantees of liabilities; development, sales, lease, and outsourcing services of various information appliances, information processing, information services, and software; investment in and financing, and transportation and warehousing activities; acquisition, maintenance, management, usage consent, and transfer of intellectual property rights; forwarding business; farmland cultivation and researching bottling livestock products; and scrap sales business. Additionally, the company manufactures and sells processed food; generate, management, administration, supply, and sale of electricity; and offers soup pouches, ready-to-eat food products, and snacks. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

MK Seiko Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells automotive services and information equipment, and household products. It offers door-type car wash machine, car wash for large vehicles, car wash for special vehicles, multi-continuous car wash machine, hand-washed car wash machine, high-pressure washer, automotive tire air filler, automotive cleaning equipment, car mat washer, fluid and oil-related equipment, LLC-related equipment, air conditioner-related equipment, kerosene delivery lorry, pump, led display for gas stations, and car wash operation support service. The company also provides information-related equipment, store display, construction display, official information boards and others, large digital signage, and LED display for gas stations. In addition, it offers niche cooking appliances, food temperature controllers, and large prefab refrigerators and freezers. MK Seiko Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Chikuma, Japan.

giftee Group, Inc. engages in the creation, distribution, and sale of e-gifts. It sells its e-gifts online via smartphones and other devices. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Yokogawa Bridge Holdings Corp. engages in the design, fabrication, and construction of steel structures in Japan and internationally. It operates through five segments: Bridge Business, System Building Business, Engineering Business, Advanced Technology Business, and Other Businesses. The company designs, fabricates, and erects steel bridge projects; and maintains, repairs, and retrofits existing structures. It is also involved in the supply of structural steel buildings for factories, storehouses, shops, and sports facilities; fabrication of port and offshore structures; and construction of high-rise buildings and dome-type sports stadiums, as well as provision of machinery for the infrastructure sector, such as water gates, shiplift facility, and sewage treatment. In addition, the company supplies metal frames for use in the production of semiconductors and flat panel displays; and provides software for the total design system for steel bridges and simulation systems for the erection of steel structures, etc. Yokogawa Bridge Holdings Corp. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Komaihaltec Inc. designs and constructs steel bridges, steel frameworks, and wind energy generating systems. The company also manufactures and installs construction machinery. It develops, constructs, and installs wind turbine systems. Komaihaltec Inc. was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

long_name: The Takigami Steel Construction Co., Ltd.
business_summary: The Takigami Steel Construction Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and constructs bridges, steel frames, steel towers, and other steel structures primarily in Japan. It is also involved in construction work, as well as repair and reinforcement work. The Takigami Steel Construction Co., Ltd. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Handa, Japan.

Nasu Denki-Tekko Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells electricity, communications, and transportation infrastructure materials in Japan. The company offers steel towers and structures, including transmission, telecommunications, and lighting towers, as well as steel frames, and equipment racks; overhead line materials, such as overhead wiring hardware, insulators, resin covers, NTT and CATV materials, wire rods, and antenna support poles for information and communications; and underground wire materials comprising cable support materials for tunnels and utility conduits, prefabricated manholes, concrete handhole products, iron covers, pipe materials, and utility pole removal materials. It also provides toll booth and transportation system materials, which include road information boards, signs, soundproof wall supports, electronic toll collection gantries, lighting and ventilation equipment, and railway overhead wire fittings; steel pipe, composite, and fabricated steel pipe columns; and assembled steel pipe poles for power generation, communications, and for disaster prevention. In addition, the company offers surface treatment solutions, such as highly corrosion-resistant plating, hot-dip zinc-aluminum alloy plating, hot-dip galvanization, low-gloss treatment, zinc phosphate treatment, and various types of painting; and air-heated hydrogen storage alloy system and hydrogen storage alloy tank. Further, it offers construction works comprising telecommunication towers, underground line facility, and road facility installation works, and deterioration diagnosis, as well as recycling of galvanized products. The company serves electric power transmission and distribution networks, telecommunications networks, disaster prevention infrastructure, roads, highways, toll plazas, tunnels, railways, public transportation systems, and infrastructure maintenance sectors. Nasu Denki-Tekko Co., Ltd. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Almetax Manufacturing Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells aluminum building materials, electrical materials, and civil engineering products in Japan. The company engages in the development, design, production, and construction of various industrial materials, such as ceramic, glass, and others, as well as environmental and landscape materials, etc.; and development research, construction, and sale of new materials, new technologies, recycling, etc. It also offers aluminum building materials, decorative windows, functional windows, bay windows, screen doors, skylights, entrances, back doors, and bathroom doors; openings, such as lattices; and exteriors, such as handrails, balconies, terraces, carports, etc. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

Sankyo Tateyama,Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of building, housing, and exterior construction materials in Japan. It also manufactures and sells fabricated products made of rolled aluminum and other metals. In addition, the company is involved in the casting, extrusion, fabrication, and sale of aluminum and magnesium; sale of commercial and general-purpose display fixtures; manufacture and sale of standard signboards and other signage products; and maintenance of stores related equipment. Sankyo Tateyama,Inc. was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Takaoka, Japan.

Alinco Incorporated develops, manufactures, and sells scaffolding equipment in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Retail Business, Rental Related Business, Household Equipment Related Business, and Electronic Equipment Related Business. It offers scaffolding materials and logistics storage equipment; steel hardwear; home equipment, such as ladders, stepladders, stationary elevated workbenches, resin moldings, trolleys, folding carts, fitness-related products, surveying and laser equipment, aluminum bridges, fitness equipment, and various type of carts and folding handcarts; and wireless communication devices. The company is also involved in the sale and rental of scaffolding materials for low-rise and medium to high-rise buildings, and temporary bleachers and oct systems. In addition, it undertakes assembly and processing of electronic equipment; develops, manufactures, and sells do-it-yourself products, aluminium mold, electronic devices, printed and multi-layer printed wiring boards, metal and related products, and health care and beauty equipment; and develops and manages real estate properties. Further, it manufactures and sells steel racks for logistics warehouses, and steel floor materials. Alinco Incorporated was formerly known as Inoue Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Alinco Incorporated in March 1983. The company was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

LIXIL Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates water technology, housing technology, and living business segments in Japan and internationally. It offers water technology products, including bathroom fixtures, showers, tiles, and faucets; housing technology products, such as window sashes, doors, and exterior building materials; and living business solutions, which provide system kitchens, vanities, and interior products and services. Further, it provides housing solutions, sells and manages real estate, and offers other services. The company markets its products under the INAX, GROHE, American Standard, TOSTEM, RICHELLE, SPAGE, EXSIOR, SUPER WALL, DXV, NODEA, COBRA, and SATO brands. The company was formerly known as LIXIL Group Corporation. LIXIL Corporation was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Otani Kogyo Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of overhead wire hardware for power distribution and communication lines, and public hearing and CATV in Japan. The company offers overhead wiring hardware, telecommunication line hardware, and community and hardware. It also provides transmission angle steel towers, outdoor steel structures for substations, equipment stands, communication radio towers, and solar panel mounting frames; headed and irregular shape studs; and lower and upper isolation base plates, as well as scribing displacement meters. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Tier IV, Inc. develops open-source software solutions for autonomous driving. It develops Autoware, which is a software for urban driverless cars and supports 3D localization, object detection, path planning and following, and lane detection. In addition, the company offers self-driving development kit; autoware loggers; and autoware remove drive kit. It also offers sensor fusion technologies and products, including laser scanners and cameras. It also offers mobility services, development services, and solution services, covering deployment of autonomous driving systems, system integration, testing, operation support, and maintenance. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Fujisash Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells sash and curtain walls in Japan. It offers sashes and curtain walls for buildings; building renewal services to various apartments and office buildings; frontage products, such as entrances of apartments and offices, as well as aperture facades of shops and showrooms; entrance sliding doors, interior fittings, and exterior products; housing construction materials, including eco shutters and eco grilles; multipurpose prefabricated house modules, storages for disaster mitigation, and high-performance housing equipment; and LED modules. The company also provides urban waste processing systems to manufacturer and sales agents; fly ash treatment plants for urban waste incineration; and plant engineering of recycling and large-sized waste disposal facilities, as well as produces building materials, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, automotive products, home appliances, office equipment, and commodities as a supplier of light metals of aluminum. In addition, it is involved in the research and development of extrusion processing technology for lightweight magnesium alloys among industrial metals. Fujisash Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Nakanishi Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells commercial kitchen equipment primarily in Japan. The company also operates in real estate rental business. It offers cooking, heating, cooling, rice cooking cleaning, disinfection and storage, hospital, and welfare equipment. The company offers its products for schools, hospitals, business establishments, fast food shops, restaurants, bakeries, etc. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Nippon Filcon Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides industrial equipment, components, and solutions in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, Australia, North America, and internationally. It operates through Industrial Functional Filter and Conveyor Business; Electronic Materials and Photomasks Business; Environment and Water Treatment Related Business; and Real Estate Rental Business segments. The company offers industrial filters and conveyor belts, such as mesh for pulp and paper manufacturing; and industrial wire mesh products for use in screening, filtering, and conveying processes in the manufacture of various products. It also provides electronic components and photomasks, including high-precision parts to the customers in electronics, automotive, office equipment, medical equipment, and other fields; stepper reticles and aligner masks for use in semiconductors and LCD; and solar power generation systems. In addition, the company offers swimming pools for elementary and junior high schools, and other public entities, as well as for fitness clubs, hotels, and other private businesses; and imports and sells insulating joints that prevent corrosion and gas leaks on natural gas pipelines, as well as wine. Further, it leases real estate properties, such as stores, condominiums, parking lots, and other properties. Nippon Filcon Co., Ltd. was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Inagi, Japan.

Noritz Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of household appliances and equipment in Japan. The company provides water heaters, and heating ventilation and air conditioning systems, such as gas water and oil water heaters; hybrid water and space heating systems; solar heating systems; waste heat recovery systems for fuel cells; hydronic floor heating systems; and gas fan heaters, as well as bathroom heating, drying, and ventilation systems. It also offers kitchen appliances, including built-in and counter-top gas cookers, gas ovens, and range hoods. In addition, the company provides after-sales and product installation services. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Tenryu Saw Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells saw blades in Japan and internationally. The company offers cutting tools, such as carbide tools for ferrous and non-ferrous metals, as well as wood applications; cutters and routers; HSS tools; and diamond saw blades, circular and band saw blades, circular knives, and miter saw blades. It also offers machines for carbide-tipped saw blades, including an ultrasonic bath for saw blades; and band saw processing machines comprising automatic band saw welders, levelers, heat-tensioning machines, hard-facing alloy tipping machines, hard-facing alloy rough grinders, side grinders, and saw sharpeners, as well as narrow band saw sharpeners. Tenryu Saw Mfg. Co., Ltd. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Fukuroi, Japan.
