Rinnai Corporation manufactures and sells thermal equipment in Japan, the United States, Australia, China, South Korea, and Indonesia. The company offers water heaters, including hot-water units, bath hot-water units, hot-water and heating units, and gas/solar hybrid hot-water and heating systems; kitchen appliances, such as tabletop stoves, built-in-stoves, ovens, range food, dishwashers, and rice cookers; and air conditioning appliances comprising fan heaters, fan-forced heaters, and infrared heaters. It also provides commercial-use ceramics grills, gas stoves, and rice cookers; and clothes dryers, and infrared burners and parts. The company sells its products under the Rinnai brand. The company was formerly known as Rinnai & Co. and changed its name to Rinnai Corporation in 1971. Rinnai Corporation was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Unipres Corporation engages in manufacture and sale of automotive parts in Japan. The company provides car body frame products, such as front side members, rear side members, cross members, side sills, front pillars, center pillars, side roof rails, front floor panel, steering members, fuel tanks, and filler tubes, as well as battery case. It also offers precision press technology products, including torque converters, clutch pack and drum, driven/retaining plate, piston plunger, carrier pack, carrier plate/base, end plate, oil pan, and parts for cooling EV motors. In addition, the company provides plastic press products comprising front and floor under covers, front fender protectors, and rear diffuser. Further, it engages in the manufacture and sale of electric machinery parts; metal products; and welders, dies, jigs, and tools, as well as inspection and maintenance of press machinery. Unipres Corporation was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Japan Power Fastening Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial fasteners and related tools in Japan. The company provides fasteners for metal, wooden, and cement-based building materials; surface treatment; tools, machines, and equipment for fastening industrial fasteners; and industrial rivet guns and rivets. It also buys, sells, leases, and manages real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Minoh, Japan.

Amatei Incorporated manufactures and sells nails, screws, nailing machines, and construction materials in Japan. It offers iron round nails, colored N nails, concrete nails, machine-driven concrete nails, mechanical steel plate nails, wire-linked nails, magazine-linked nails, stainless steel screw ring nails, wood splitting nails, screw nails, floor nails, roofing nails, sheet-connecting nails, and cement coated nails. The company also trades in steel. Amatei Incorporated was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacture, and sale of metal products in Japan, Thailand, Asia, and internationally. The company offers tapping fasteners for metals, resin, plastic, and thin plates; aluminum alloy zipper, CFRP fasteners, anti-loosening fasteners, crimp bolts, washer assembled screws, and head shape products; and custom-made products, such as neck tight screws and small metal parts. It also provides contract test and consulting services. The company serves car, home appliances and industrial equipment, medical equipment, robot, and architecture industries. The company was formerly known as Yamashina Corporation and changed its name to Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2024. Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

Toso Company, Limited engages in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of interior decoration products worldwide. It offers curtain rail, hanging bar, picture rail, tassel hook, tassel; dimmable, and roller blinds, vertical blinds, pleated and honeycomb screen, colt; wood and aluminum blinds; roman shades, external roller screen, accordion door, vinyl curtains; and electric products. The company develops and sells walking sticks and other items through agents, home improvement centers, and nursing care specialty stores. Toso Company, Limited was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Nittoseiko Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial fasteners and tools, industrial machinery and precision equipment, measurement and control equipment, and medical equipment in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Fastener; Industrial Machinery; Control; and Medical segments. The company offers screws for plastics and metal fastening, cold forged parts, anti-loosening screws, drive recesses, heads, self-clinching stud bolts, surface treatment products, waterproof screws, products for joining of dissimilar materials, and other metal parts; and screw driving motors, handheld type screw drivers, arm drivers, single and multi-spindle screw driving machines, screw driving robots, screw feeders, anti-contamination units, screw driving units for collaborative robots, caulking machines, assembly robots, and conveyors. It also provides flow meters, receivers/converters, micro-bubble washers, products for marine and batch applications, and geokartes. Nittoseiko Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

Sanyo Industries, Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of metallic building materials in Japan. The company is involved in the manufacture, sale, and contract work of metallic building materials, and internal and external materials; design and manufacture of air-conditioning and ventilation systems, and associated equipment; sale and contract work of solar energy equipment; and export and import of other related products and materials. It also offers aluminum products, including handrails, copings, louvers, and spandrail; system floors, such as multipurpose, magic, deck, and condominium floors; and forced and natural ventilation products; and metal frame, natural lighting, system ceiling, filler, and wire and metal products. Sanyo Industries, Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Sumida, Japan.

Okabe Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells construction and civil engineering products in Japan, North America, and internationally. It offers temporary construction products, such as clamps, scaffolding, inserts for scaffolding, temporary pass, and safety products; concrete formwork products, including separator, cone, form tie, flat rib, overtightening restrainer, corner fastener, panel adjuster, slab jointer, bottom pipe supporting hook, and leakage cover; items for h-beam, sheet pile method, insulation , and other formwork; water stop/disposal products; insert and rooftop protection products; and chamfers. The company also provides rebar work products, which include joints, pile head, spacers, footing beam stand for foundation, and beam lowering stand for beam, as well as civil engineering products. Okabe Co., Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Asaka Industrial Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells shovels and scoops in Japan. It operates through two segments: Living-related products and Logistics equipment segments. The Living-related products segment sells excavators, outdoor goods, and construction and agricultural equipment. The Logistics equipment segment sells electric mobile shelves, rotating racks, heavy, medium and light weight racks, transportation equipment, and others. It also offers spades; outdoor equipment, including gardening tools; farming tools; fixtures; and wooden products. Asaka Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1661 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

Fujimak Corporation engages in the manufacture, sale, maintenance, and repair of commercial kitchen equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers ovens, teppanyaki grills, fryer oil filters, gas ranges, induction stoves, warmers, griddles, salamander roasters, noodle boilers, rotary cooking kettle braising pans, dumpling grillers, steamers, package cookers, and reheating cabinets, as well as electric ranges, tables, and stock pot ranges; refrigerators, freezers, blast chillers, showcases, cold food carts, ice makers, and vacuum and tabletop coolers; Kitchen Link Cloud, a cloud-based temperature management system; Kitchen Link, a system that centrally manages data; I-Robo2, a stir-fry cooking robot; finibo, a system that automates the picking and sorting cleaned dishes; and island and custom-made home kitchens. It also provides dishwashers, cookware washers, sterilizer cabinets, and ultraviolet sterilizers; cleaning agents for washing machines; carts; automatic rice cookers, storage products, and silos; bakery equipment; cabinets and camshelving equipment; Pacojet, a frozen pulverizing cooker; vacuum packing machines, blenders and mixers, and cookers; gelato/ice cream service equipment, drink dispensers and machines, auxiliary cooking equipment, and water heaters; and sanitary sinks and bars, automatic hand sanitizer dispensers, air showers, electrolyzed water generators, digital probe thermometers, and water softeners and purifiers. The company sells its products online. It serves government agencies and public institutions; educational institutions and school lunch centers; medical and welfare facilities; hotels, inns, and lodging facilities; restaurants and izakayas; amusement facilities; fast food establishments; convenience stores; food processing plants and central kitchens; company cafeterias; ship kitchen facilities; and other industries. Fujimak Corporation was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Kyoto Tool Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive maintenance tools, medical tools and related equipment, electrical tools, and other general tools in Japan. It operates in two segments, Tool Business and Facility Management Business. The company also offers ratchet handle and compact head ratchet, as well as wooden grip screwdriver set. It sells its products under the nepros brand through online store. In addition, the company engages in the leasing of real estate; and sale of electricity generated by solar power generation. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Kuse, Japan.

G-Tekt Corporation manufactures and sells auto body components and transmission parts in Japan and internationally. It provides auto body components, such as dashboards, side structures, rear seat reinforcement components, frames, and floor components; vehicle transmission parts; and dies and production systems. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

Kyowakogyosyo Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells hexagon bolts, JIS hexagon socket head cap screws, bolts, cold-forged parts, and special cold-/hot-forged parts in Japan and internationally. It also offers automobile parts, such as transmission, steering and suspension, and other forging parts; gears; and industrial bolts and bolts products. The company serves construction machinery, industrial machinery, marine internal combustion engine, heavy equipment, industrial fastening, forged components, automobiles and mechanical engineering sectors. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Komatsu, Japan.

Chugokukogyo Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells high voltage, steel structure, and facility equipment in Japan. The company offers LP gas containers, LP gas storage tanks, cylinders, and bulk storage tanks; steel, aluminum alloy, fluorocarbon, and other containers; and corrosive, toxic, and other special gas cylinders, as well as designs, constructs, and inspects LP gas filling plants. It also provides inner cover for annealing furnace; can manufacturing equipment, including data recorder enclosure and pressure transformer vessel; and other steel structural products. In addition, the company offers feed distribution products, such as FRP feed tanks, feed containers, feed transfer stations, and silage silos; livestock equipment and products comprising wet feeders and pipe barns; BM method and fine mist deodorizing devices; environmental conservation facility equipment; fisheries equipment and materials, which include aquaculture, breeding, and experimental tanks; and FRP pharmaceutical tanks, covers, automotive parts, vehicle wash basin units, and other FRP products for plants. Further, it provides plastic containers. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Kure, Japan.

Topre Corporation engages in the press-related products and temperature-controlled logistics-related businesses in Japan. The company offers press-related products; ultra-high-tensile steel plates and hot stamp pressed product; and constant temperature logistics products for light vehicles and heavy vehicles, as well as compact, 2t, 3t, and 4t trucks. It also provides home ventilation system; and electronic products, such as keyboards, pin pads, ouch monitor, touch panel, and embedded computer. In addition, the company offers automotive press components, office equipment parts, and press dies; and freezing containers, freezing equipment, freezers and refrigerators, and temperature-controlled logistics centers. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Press Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Topre Corporation in October 1985. Topre Corporation was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Neturen Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel bars in Japan and internationally. It operates through Specialty Steel and Wire Products, Induction Heating, and Others segments. The company offers prestressed concrete (PC) steel bars, deformed PC steel bars, and shear reinforcement products for civil engineering and construction applications; high-strength spring steel wire (ITW) products for the use in suspension springs for automobiles and two-wheeled vehicles; automotive parts; construction machine parts; machining equipment; pre-grout PC steel bar; double stark; ball screw shaft material; and pre-hardened wires and steel. It is also involved in the manufacturing and sale of induction heating equipment and high-frequency hardening equipment; contract processing, manufacturing, and sale of high-frequency quenching of machine parts, etc.; provision of induction heat treatment services for critical safety parts of automobiles, machining equipment, and industrial machine parts; and development of technical products business; and slot lamination tape for communications. In addition, the company leases movables and real estate properties; and integrated processing, includes hollow rack bars, front inner tubes, slewing bearings, and partial diameter enlargement processing. Neturen Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1940 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Tokyo Rope Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells wire ropes, steel cords, and carbon fiber composite cables (CFCCs) in Japan, China, and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Steel Code-Related; Steel Cord Related; Development Product-Related; Industrial Machinery-Related; and Energy Real Estate-Related. It offers its wire ropes that are used in cranes, elevators, forestry and fisheries, rope slings, and cableways; galvanized wires and strands for use in electric power and communication fields; and steel cords, including steel tire cords that are used in steel radial tires, hose wires to reinforce high pressure hose, and saw wires to produce wafers and chips. The company also provides engineering, bridge and structural cable, and carbon fiber composite cable products, as well as aluminum conductor fiber reinforced products. In addition, it designs and constructs road safety devices, such as rock fall prevention nets; and environment protection products, including sound insulation walls, and bridges and cable-suspended bridges, as well as manufactures and sells various industrial machinery and metal fibers. The company was incorporated in 1887 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Maruzen Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of commercial kitchen equipment in Japan. It offers fryers, steam convection ovens, dishwashers, gas ranges/ gas table stove, noodle boiler, rice washer/rice cooker, small bakery equipment, Gyoza cooker, gas burner, and other products. The company also engages in manufacturing, purchasing, and sales of large bread making machinery. Additionally, it is involved in the leasing of building. Maruzen Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Iwabuchi Corporation manufactures and sells electrical overhead wire hardware for electric power, communication, signals, broadcasting, and railway industries in Japan. The company offers power transmission and distribution equipment parts; communication equipment; broadcasting and supporting equipment; synthetic resin electrical insulation materials; and other electrical connection equipment. It also undertakes construction, electrical, telecommunication, designing, supervision, and facility contracting works. In addition, the company provides distribution line, CATV/information communication, traffic lights and road signs, school physical education facility, and disaster prevention radio services. Further, it offers seismic technology, contract testing, and renewable energy related services, as well as services for EV charging stations. Iwabuchi Corporation was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Matsudo, Japan.

Kanefusa Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial and machine knives, sawblades, tools, and machinery parts in Japan, Indonesia, The United States, Europe, China, Brazil, Vietnam, and internationally. The company offers saw blades, router and dowel bits, cutters, ace cutters and bits, finger joint cutters, cutter heads and knives, wood chipping products, and plywood knives for the wood based industry; and cold saw blades, ferrous and non-ferrous saw blades, non-ferrous cold saw blades, reamers and drills, face mill products, and other ferrous cutting tools for metal, aluminum, stainless steel, pipe sawing, and other applications. It also provides paper guillotine, trimmer, bookbinding, sheeter, and slitter knives for use in printing, book binding, and paper manufacturing applications; TCT saw blades, end mills, drills, and cutter heads for plastic applications; and PCD tools, such as saw blades, cutters, and router bits for ceramic and cement siding boards. In addition, it offers chipper and crusher knives for recycling industry, as well as hydraulic tool holders, centerless blades, and tool grinders for precision processes in machines. The company was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Niwa, Japan.

Suncall Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes automotive parts and materials, Printer-related products, and Communications-related products in Japan, North America, and Asia. The company offers Steel wire for valve springs, precision shaped wire, valve springs, valve cotters, spiral springs for variable valve timing system, transmission springs, shaped rings (snap rings), wave rings/wave springs, accordion springs, drive plates, ring gears, boot clamps, detent springs, spiral spring for seatbelts, tension reducers, sensor rings, ECU control parts, motor cores/stator cores, reactor coils, bus bars, and shunt busbar. It also sells bus rings, inspection pins for wire harnesses, small springs, heat-resistant springs, press parts, shafts for business machines, resin-coated TUBE shafts, TUBE shafts, carriage guide shafts, clutches for business machines, torque limiters, connectors and adapters for optical communications, bamboo charcoal, probes, and unit assemblies for inspections. The company was formerly known as Sanko Senzai Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Suncall Corporation in April 1991. Suncall Corporation was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

Molitec Steel Co., Ltd. processes and sells colored steel strips, hot rolled steel strips, and steel strips in Japan and internationally. The company trades in steel materials, such as stainless-steel strips and ordinary steel, tempered steel strips; and manufactures and sells processed sheet metal products, including cord reels and springs, as well as processed sheet metal products, including cord reels and springs. The company was formerly known as Mori&Co. and changed its name to Molitec Steel Co., Ltd. in January 1990. Molitec Steel Co., Ltd. was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

ONEX Corporation provides metal heat treatment, remediation, and processing services in Japan and internationally. The company offers metal heat treatment services, including carburizing, carbonitriding, vacuum, high frequency, bright heat, and aluminum alloy heat treatment. Its metal heat treatment services also consist of quenching and tempering, nitriding, gas nitrocarburizing, shot peening, and PVD coating treatment services, as well as heat treatments for oversized parts. In addition, it provides logistics and information system development services. The company serves industrial machine tools, automobile parts, and construction machinery sectors. The company was formerly known as Oya Netsushori Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ONEX Corporation in July 1991. ONEX Corporation was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Machida, Japan.

PIOLAX, Inc. designs, develops, produces, and sells various parts and products for the automotive, medical, and consumer and security industries in Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. It offers valves and fuel parts for filling, storing, and providing petrol; connectors for piping used around radiators; compact filters for fuel and oil systems; evapo-tube ASSY products; and connectors with the invented resin tubes. The company also provides powertrain parts, which include various springs that are used for transmissions, and snap rings used for holding parts; open-close parts, including air dampers, latches, and cushions for glove boxes; resin and metal fasteners for fixing automobile interior/exterior parts and connecting pipes to car body; and harnesses for bundling electric wires. In addition, it offers precision parts comprising retainers and tension springs to hold wheel caps; injection-molded parts for automotive interior/exterior; and visor-related parts and luggage board handles, as well as plate clamps and screw clamps. Further, the company provides medical appliances, such as spiral catheters and stents; and consumer and security products, including springs for combination faucets, and security parts to seal money bags or container vehicles, as well as hot water blocking valves and headphone wire bands. The company was formerly known as Kato Hatsujo Inc. and changed its name to PIOLAX, Inc. in October 1995. PIOLAX, Inc. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

H-One Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive and motorcycle parts, and dies and welding equipment in Japan, North America, Asia, and China. The company offers automobile frames, including front bulkhead, front side frame, rear frame, rear wheelhouse comp, and pillar comp, as well as door beams. It also provides motorcycle and power products, such as control levers, yoke rotors, and pushrods; and metal separators and 3DQ body frames, as well as dies and welding equipment. The company was formerly known as Hirata Technical Co., Ltd., and changed its name to H-One Co.,Ltd. in April 2006. H-One Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

ChatPlus Co.,Ltd. develops and provides SaaS-based subscription-based chatbot systems in Japan. The chatbot system is a service that supports companies in improving operational efficiency and productivity by automating and reducing the manpower required to handle inquiries from both inside and outside the company. It offers ChatPlus, a chatbot that supports the automation of corporate inquiry handling and communication, employing a format; AI Agent Plus, a chatbot that integrates generation AI such as ChatCPT with Chat Plus to generate optimal responses on the spot in addition to registered answers, enabling it to handle complex inquiries and diverse expressions from visitors and provide natural conversational responses; and FAQPlus, a system for creating, organizing, and managing articles of frequently asked questions and answers, so that users can easily find the answers they need. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

NHK Spring Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells automotive parts in Japan, rest of Asia, America, Europe, and internationally. It operates in five segments: Automotive Suspension Springs Business, Automotive Seating Business, Precision Springs and Components Business, DDS Business, and Industrial Machinery and Equipment and Other Operations Business. The company offers coil and leaf springs, stabilizer bars and links, accumulators, torsion bars, and stabilinkers; automobile seats, mechanical components for seats, and interior components; HDD mechanical components, wire and flat springs, motor cores, fasteners/screws, and precision machine components. It also provides HDD suspensions and semiconductor testing probe units; and semiconductor process and spring components, ceramic products, piping support equipment, integrated metal substrates, parking equipment, security products, lighting fixtures, golf shafts, and electronic remote control for ships. In addition, the company offers hollow and solid stabilizers; bush bonding; spring grid arrays; medical bellows; flexible joints; door sunshades; tonneau covers; bolts; chain tensioners; control cables; brake discs; assist and tension balancers; lock hinges; top covers; disk clamps; base plates; stage heaters; cooling plates; shower heads; micro contractors; test sockets; probe heads; direct bonded insulator circuits; anti-counterfeit labels; distribution control authenticity judgment and machine recognition hologram systems; pipe clamps; SD and UK park; parking system with EV chargers; turnouts; rail fastening devices; synthetic rail tiles; and metal bats for baseball and softball. The company was formerly known as Shibaura Spring Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NHK Spring Co., Ltd. in 1939. NHK Spring Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Chuo Spring Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of springs, control cables, building materials and equipment, and automotive products in Japan, North America, China, and Asia. The company offers chassis springs, such as coil springs, stabilizers, leaf springs, torsion bars, and ODDS, an on demand disconnectable stabilizer; and precision springs, including precision coil springs, valve springs, heat-resistant springs, power back door springs, spiral springs, wire springs, knitted mesh springs, and assembly products. It also provides transmission cables, parking brake cables, opener cables, door lock cables, and power sliding door cables; and customized springs to aftermarket specifications. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Fine Sinter Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automobile parts, railway vehicle parts, and hydraulic units worldwide. It offers automotive parts, including engine, drivetrain, motor-related, shock absorber, and other automotive parts that are used in engines, transmissions, steering systems, and various sensors. The company also offers parts for railway vehicles, such as piston rod packing, collecting contact strip, grounding brush, and brake lining products; and parts for industrial machinery comprising flanges, sintered vents, spherical seats, bushing families, and hydraulic parts for construction machinery, as well as copiers, cameras, electric tools, and others. In addition, it provides hydraulic unit products for medical field comprising chairs, operating tables, diagnostic imaging equipment, and others. Fine Sinter Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Kasugai, Japan.

Advanex Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of precision springs in Japan and internationally. It offers wire springs, including compression, extension, torsion, conical, and wire forming springs; and flat springs, such as precision presses, multi formings, forging presses, and insert collars. The company also provides deep drawings; insert moldings; spring assemblies; and standard products comprising tangles inserts, tangles insert kits, LockOne, and instant lock products; and HEATNEX, a heating elements. The company was formerly known as Kato Spring Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Advanex Inc. in July 2001. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Miura Co., Ltd. produces and sells boilers in Japan and internationally. The company offers small once-through boilers, marine auxiliary boilers, exhaust gas boilers, sterilizers, chemicals, and water tube boilers. It also provides equipment sales and maintenance, and environmental measurement services. In addition, the company is involved in laundry equipment, marine equipment, water treatment equipment, food processing, and medical equipment businesses. Miura Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Matsuyama, Japan.

Takuma Co., Ltd. engages in the design, construction, and superintendence of various boilers, plant machineries, pollution prevention and environmental equipment plants, heating and cooling equipment, and feed water/drainage sanitation equipment and facilities in Japan. The company engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction of municipal solid waste and water treatment plants; and power retail business, as well as provides after sales services, including plant maintenance, operation management, and O&M. It also constructs and maintains biomass power plants and waste-to-energy plants. In addition, the company manufactures, sells, and maintains general purpose boilers, such as small once-through boilers and vacuum hot water generators, which are used as heat-sources at commercial facilities and factories, as well as clean equipment and cleaning devices for use in the semiconductor industry; and designs and constructs building equipment, including air-conditioning, plumbing, etc. The company was formerly known as Takuma Boiler Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Takuma Co., Ltd. in 1972. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

Japan Engine Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, maintains, repairs, sells, and licenses marine internal combustion engines and related components in Japan, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. It offers UE engines used in bulk carriers, tankers, car carrier ships, container ships, and other vessels. The company also engages in the manufacture and sale of shield machine components for subway construction and tunnel boring; and machining and assembly of large sized products, including injection molding machines and testing devices. In addition, it provides pressure-relief control valve blocks, cylinder covers, piston crowns, piston heads and metallic sliding bearings, bedplates and shield machines, and resin granulators. The company was formerly known as Kobe Diesel Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Japan Engine Corporation in April 2017. The Hanshin Diesel Works, Ltd. manufactures and sells marine diesel engines and propulsion systems for ships worldwide. It operates through the Main Engine, and Components and Repair Work segments. The company offers engines comprising low-speed four-stroke engines, medium-speed engines, and low-speed two-stroke engines; remote control system for main engines; and engine monitoring and support systems for ship administration. It also offers propulsion systems, such as controllable pitch propellers and side thrusters; remote control systems and integrated control systems; casting and metal machining; and auxiliary devices, including lubricating oil and fuel oil purifiers, fuel oil fine filters, and LG-type lubricating oil filters. The company was formerly known as The Hanshin Ironworks Co., Ltd. and changed its name to The Hanshin Diesel Works, Ltd. in 1944. The Hanshin Diesel Works, Ltd. was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Akasaka Diesels Limited manufactures and sells ship diesel engines, and various machinery and equipment in Japan and internationally. Its product portfolio includes 4 stroke and 2 stroke diesel engines, remote controllers, engine monitoring devices, low pressure SCR and EGR systems, fuel injection boosters, DCB flexible couplings, lubricating systems, soundproof room systems, and floating floor systems, as well as engine doctor, and advanced electronically controlled lubrication system. The company is also involved in the design, manufacture, repair, and sale of marine internal combustion engines and their components, as well as industrial and civil engineering machinery accessories.Akasaka Diesels Limited was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Daihatsu Infinearth Mfg.Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells marine engines, land engines, and industrial instruments in Japan, China, Asia, Central America, South America, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Marine Engine Related and Land Engine Related segments. It offers marine engine products, including propulsion systems, electric propulsion systems, auxiliary systems, and dual-fuel engines, as well as marine engines for nitrogen oxide regulations. The company also provides land diesel engines and gas turbines/gas engines for emergency power generation/pumping; and co-generation systems. In addition, it provides industrial instruments, such as aluminum wheels, oil mist detectors and monitors, and doughnut RD couplings. Further, the company is involved in real estate leasing business; transportation, warehouse management, precision components, and contracting businesses; and solar power generation business. Daihatsu Infinearth Mfg.Co.,Ltd was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Bengo4.com,Inc. offers online professional consultancy services in Japan. The company operates through Media Business and Solution Business segments. The Media Business segment operates Bengoshi.com, a legal consultation portal site; lawyer.com and Tax Accountant.com, a tax consultation portal site; and Business Lawyers.com, the corporate legal affairs portal site. It includes lawyer support, paid membership, tax accountant support, and advertising and other services. The Solutions Business segment provides IT and solution services, including CloudSign, a contract management platform. Bengo4.com,Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Artra Group Corporation provides support services for acupuncture and osteopathic clinics in Japan. It operates through two segments: A-COMS Business and Toy Sales Business. The company operates a chain of moxibustion and osteopathic clinics under the Honetsugi brand name, as well as consulting services. It also sells equipment to osteopathic clinics and moxibustion clinics; consumables, such as moxibustion, bandages, moxa, taping, and other items used in osteopathic and moxibustion clinics, self-paid treatment equipment, and private treatment equipment through an e-commerce site under the Atlas Store name. In addition, the company offers Atlas billing services; HONEY-STYLE, a sales support system for moxibustion and osteopathic clinics; and nursing care support services. Further, the company sells toys, stationery, and other items. The company was formerly known as artra corporation and changed its name to Artra Group Corporation in 2021. Artra Group Corporation was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Adventure, Inc. operates an online travel reservation platform under the skyticket name. It offers air ticket booking, local tours, private lodging management, and offshore development services. Adventure, Inc. was formerly known as Cyber Travel Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Adventure Inc. in June 2013. Adventure, Inc. was founded in 2004 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Zeta Inc. engages in digital marketing solutions business in Japan. The company offers ZETA SEARCH, an e-commerce product search and site search engine; ZETA AD which allows to set up ad space on various pages, such as search result pages, product detail pages, and cart pages; ZETA GEO, a solution that optimizes e-commerce sites for AI-generated searches; ZETA HASHTAG, analyzes text, including product descriptions and reviews, and extracts keywords related to the product as hashtags; ZETA VOICE that implement review content on website. Zeta Inc. was formerly known as Scigineer Inc. Zeta Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Extreme Co.,Ltd. engages in the digital human resource, contract development, and content property businesses in Japan. The company offers customer-resident smartphone applications, IT, and WEB software development services; and smartphone apps, cloud platform contract development services. It also provides various games, digital content, web systems, and license services. The company serves corporates and individuals. Extreme Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

MRT Inc. operates a medical information platform. It provides Gaikin, a recruitment service specializing in part-time physicians; career, a job change support service for doctors; re:ray, a one stop outsourcing service; Door., an app to connect network of doctors; Door.into, an app platform that connects doctors and medical institutions with individuals; Pocket Doctor, a telemedicine app; groupware for medical departments; and FASTCALL a safety confirmation service for medical institutions consolidating the functions for hospital crisis management systems. The company also offers stem cell culture supernatant for medical institutions; pharmacist, clinical engineering technician, radiologic technologists, dialysis nurses, new practice openings and succession cases, clinical laboratory technician, and nurse recruitment services; job posting service for full-time and part-time industrial physicians; occupational health services; employment placement services; life support services; and full-time, part-time, and temporary positions for healthcare and welfare professionals. In addition, it engages in book publishing on illness and treatment; medical worker job placement business; business start-up; business succession support business; PR services, comprehensive membership compensation system, tax accountant referral services, and human umbilical cord-derived culture supernatant. Further, it offers anew, a service aimed at payroll calculation for doctors part-time jobs and payroll transfer agency services; Medikiki, an information distribution platform connecting manufacturers and wholesalers; and Kids Line that provides babysitting services. MRT Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

IR Japan Holdings, Ltd. provides investor and shareholder relation consulting services to publicly traded companies, investors, and market participants in Japan. It provides equity consulting services, including shareholder identification survey, voting simulation, activist and hostile takeover risk analysis, corporate value enhancement advisory, strategic review, balance sheet simulation, corporate governance consulting, ESG consulting, and stock transfer agency. The company also provides merger and acquisition (M&A) services, such as financial advisory for M&A execution, corporate acquisition, corporate merger, and corporate sale, as well as management buyout advisory/leveraged buyout advisory. In addition, it offers investment banking services comprising financial advisory/proxy advisory for contest for corporate control and takeover bid, and activist defense, as well as proxy contest and takeover bid; and global and AI research framework services. KeePer Technical Laboratory Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells car coatings, car washing chemicals and equipment, and other products in Japan. The company also offers interior cleaning products and sheet metal paints. It operates through directly managed stores, franchise stores, and Keeper Pro Shops. KeePer Technical Laboratory Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Obu, Japan.

RAKUMACHI,Inc. operates a real estate investment portal site under the Rakumachi name in Japan. Its site offers services that enables users to learn about real estate investment, search for real estate, and sell real estate. The company was formerly known as Firstlogic,Inc. and changed its name to RAKUMACHI,Inc. in October 2024. RAKUMACHI,Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

IID, Inc. engages in the media, research, and media commerce businesses in Japan. It operates through Creator platform business and Creator solution business segments. The company operates various media centered and news websites comprising business, practical, hobbies, information technology, automobiles, education, movies, games, anime, fashion, and other media content. It also offers content and research solutions and media consulting to customers, as well as quantitative and qualitative surveys; and shop management ASP systems for EC businesses. In addition, it engages in publishing and online advertising business. The company was formerly known as IRI Commerce & Technology Inc. and changed its name to IID, Inc. in June 2010. IID, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nippon Ski Resort Development Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manages and operates ski resorts in Japan. It also provides consulting and advisory services on ski resorts, including technical support, business support, designated management, rental business support, and other services; contract management of cableway; and rental of outdoor equipment, as well as manages parking lot. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kitaazumi, Japan. Nippon Ski Resort Development Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Nippon Parking Development Co., Ltd.

Nikki Co., Ltd. researches, designs, develops, and sells carburetors and fuel equipment in Japan and internationally. The company provides electric motors; fuel cell stack related products, including regulators for hydrogen, gaseous injectors, valves of fuel cell bypass, and safety valves for hydrogen; clean energy products, such as regulators for hydrogen, gaseous injectors, regulators for ammonia, and electric throttle body products; Fuel supply system for engine and parts that comprise CNG systems, engine electronic control units, sensors, and motor driving devices; and gaseous fuel engine equipment, that includes CNG/LPG-MPI fuel rail assembly, LPG-MPI fuel rail assembly, CNG/LPG-SPI fuel rail assembly, CNG/LNG regulators, LPG-vaporizers, EGR valves and CNG/LPG fuel filters. It also offers industrial engine components and gaseous fueled general purpose engine components comprising throttle body for general purpose engines, general purpose carburetors, general purpose carburetors, GHP-zero governors, GHP -mixers, and general purpose FI engine fuel pump modules; and electronic control equipment that comprise electronic control unit for CNG engines. It serves automotive, industrial, and real estate sectors. The company was formerly known as Nippon Carburetor Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nikki Co., Ltd. in 2001. Nikki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1932 and is headquartered in Atsugi, Japan.

Linkbal Inc. operates event e-commerce sites and other websites in Japan. The company operates machicon JAPAN, an experiential consumption platform that lists various events for its users; CoupLink, an online dating/marriage matching app; Pairy, an app for couples; and KOIGAKU, a dating information media platform. It also provides 1on1 for Singles, a cafe lounge that provides one-on-one encounters. Linkbal Inc. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Gunosy Inc. primarily engages in the operation of news and information applications in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Media Business, G Holdings Business, and New Businesses. The Media Business segment includes Gunosy, a mobile application that provides information curation service; au Service Today, an all-in-one application that provides news, weather, transit information, fortune-telling, etc.; and operates domestic and international Game8 media business. The G Holdings Business segment involves in publishing social games, such as anime and manga. The New Businesses segment offers IR Hub, a timely disclosure support service for information disclosure; operates store and commerce business, such as S8 Shops, a service for building and managing external payment websites; and Game8 Store, an e-commerce service within Game8 that enables the sale of in-game items and game download keys. The company also offers News Lite, a news and information application available; and YOU IN, a wellness application. It is also involved in growth investment; investment business and consulting; and media, advertising, and entertainment businesses. beABLE CO.,LTD. engages in construction business and renewable energy business in Japan. The construction business focuses on maintenance and inspection work for nuclear power plants; The renewable energy business focuses on development, construction, and maintenance of renewable energy. It also engages in day care service for the elderly, gym services, and restaurant services. In addition, the company engages in electricity retail business. beABLE CO.,LTD. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Futaba, Japan.

E-Guardian Inc. provides Internet security services in Japan, Singapore, and internationally. The company offers consulting, AI solutions, cyber security, debugging, rating, web content monitoring, advertisement review and operation support, customer support, social media, and global services. E-Guardian Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Livesense Inc. engages in the internet media business in Japan. The company operates Machbaito, a part-time job recruitment website; and Tenshoku Kaigi, a job-change review site that provides job seekers with information posted by site members, including company reviews, official company information, job openings, and information sent out by the companies. It also operates TenshokuDRAFT, a job-change service for IT engineers; IESHIL, which provides real estate information services; and baton, a cloud-based online interview service. Livesense Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

JAPAN MATERIAL Co., Ltd. operates in the electronics and graphics businesses in Japan, Taiwan, Singapore, and internationally. The company operates through Electronics Related Business, Graphics Solutions Business, and Solar Power Generation Business segments. The company develops, manufactures, and sells gas supply equipment for semiconductor and LCD manufacturing; total facility and gas management, and maintenance services; and designs and constructs piping for special gas and chemicals, ultrapure water, vacuum, and general equipment, as well as sells gas, vision systems, and advanced driver assistance systems. It also engages in designing, inspection, operation, and maintenance of satellite and rocket tracking equipment; offers specialty chemical management; power and abatement management and maintenance, as well as engages in the maintenance of manufacturing equipment; vacuum pump overhauling; and clean room environmental quality control. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacture, sale, cleaning, and maintenance of ceramic coating and semiconductor manufacturing equipment parts. Further, it imports, sells, and markets graphic boards, I/O boards, other parts for personal computers, digital signage equipment, and application systems for broadcasting and video; offers application development and maintenance support services; and develops and sells handling tools, as well as generates solar power with an output of approximately 3.9 MW. JAPAN MATERIAL Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Mie, Japan.

Vector Inc. engages in the public relations (PR) and advertising businesses in Japan, China, and internationally. The company is also involved in public relations (PR) agency and consulting, branding activities, press release distribution, investor relations support, celebrity casting, risk management, market research, event planning and operation, SNS communication, and marketing businesses. Vector Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

UCHIYAMA HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the nursing care business in Japan. The company offers paid nursing homes; housing for the elderly with services; group homes; short stays; helper stations; care plan centers; day service centers; small-scale multifunctional home care facilities; visiting nursing stations; after-school day care services for children with disabilities; and on-site childcare facilities. It also operates karaoke bars under Korokke Club name; and food and beverage business operates izakaya restaurants under the Kantekiya, Saisei Sakaba, and Fujama Sakura names. In addition, the company is involved in the rental and management services for rental apartments, and real estate sales and brokerage services; vocational training business; tutoring services; and personnel placement services targeting foreign workers and support services. UCHIYAMA HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Kitakyushu, Japan.

UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA Co., Ltd. engages in the rental of plants and flowers in Japan. It rents plants for various venues, such as offices, hotels, restaurants, commercial spaces, showrooms, etc.; rents artificial flower arrangements; and provides landscape, gardening, and plant maintenance services. The company also offers greenery and flower gifts; artificial trees; greenery systems, such as rooftop gardening, planted wall murals, etc.; event decoration; flower arrangements; and garden flowerbeds and planters. In addition, it provides LED lights and illumination displays; rents photos and aquariums, as well as various cleaning products, such as entrance mats, mops, cleaning cloths, air cleaners, futon cleaning, etc.; and operates an online shop that offers various goods to corporate and individual assessors. Further, the company provides floral arrangements for wedding; and sells plants, flowers, containers, soils, fertilizers, gardening goods, fresh vegetables, breads, and other products, as well as pebbles, stones, and garden furniture products through garden centers. Additionally, it operates Ricoche+, a garden center for greeneries shopping; flower shop under the Fleur Universelle name; and garden-style café under the Les Grands Arbres brand name, which offers fresh meals. UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA Co., Ltd. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Ibaraki, Japan.

Charm Care Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides nursing care services in Japan. It operates in two segments, Long-Term Care Business and Other Businesses. The company develops, manages, and operates paid nursing homes and elderly care facilities. It is also involved in the staffing, recruitment, visiting nursing, and tenant introduction businesses, as well as provision of nursing care DX consultation services. The company was formerly known as Fuji Clinic Laboratory Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Charm Care Corporation in December 2007. Emergency Assistance Japan Co., Ltd. provides medical assistance services in Japan and internationally. Trenders, Inc. engages in the marketing and investment businesses in Japan. It also provides AMPULE career; AKANE Magazine; and Mimi Beauty, a social media beauty platform. In addition, the company is involved in event production business under the ZENPLUS; planning, developing, manufacturing, and selling products for clinics; and operates DOCTORS PICKS Online Shop, an e-commerce mall for clinic-exclusive products. Trenders, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Careerlink Co., Ltd. provides human resource services in Japan. It offers personnel services for BPO-related businesses, including dispatching of personnel to BPO businesses that are suffering from labor shortages; CRM-related services; general office work services, such as dispatching of human resources for various general administrative work and office work. Careerlink Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

IBJ, Inc. provides marriage hunting services in Japan. The company operates Bridal Net, a marriage hunting website; marriage consulting agencies under the Sunmarie and ZWEI names; and youbride, a marriage and remarriage matching app service. It is also involved in event-related business, such as parties, matchmaking get-togethers, community gatherings; directly managed marriage-hunting lounge business; marriage consulting federation business; franchise business; and life design business. Jibannet Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates in residential ground compensation industry in Japan. Jibannet Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Asante Incorporated provides house amenities and total sanitation services in Japan. The company provides termite control, humidity control, earthquake countermeasures, and renovation/new construction services, as well as solar power generation systems. It also offers bed bug, pest, animal, and bird control services. The company was formerly known as Sanyo Shodoku Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Asante Incorporated in January 1994. every,Inc. owns and operates various platforms that provide video media and advertising solutions in Japan. Allied Architects, Inc. engages in the marketing DX support business in Japan, the United States, and internationally. It also provides solutions for SNS advertising and account management, web promotions, and fan marketing solutions. ERI Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides building confirmation and inspection services in Japan. Architects Studio Japan Inc. provides design and construction support services in Japan. Shin Maint Holdings Co.,Ltd. provides maintenance services primarily in Japan. It offers store and facilities equipment, and interior and exterior fittings related maintenance services. ABIST Co.,Ltd. engages in industrial design engineering service business in Japan. It is involved in the contracting based and engineers staffing activities. SIGMAXYZ Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides consulting services in Japan. The company was formerly known as SIGMAXYZ Inc. and changed its name to SIGMAXYZ Holdings Inc. in October 2021. SIGMAXYZ Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Will Group, Inc. provides human resource support services in Japan and internationally. The company engages in the temporary staffing, outsourcing, and recruitment, as well as permanent placement services. It also provides sales outlets, call centers, food processing plants, nursing homes, and construction companies outsourcing services, as well as staffing and recruitment services in Singapore and Australia; and supports for construction management engineers. In addition, the company develops and operates Refcome and Refcome Teams services which revitalize referral hiring, and operating community-type rental housing for tech professionals. Human Metabolome Technologies, Inc., biotechnology company, develops metabolomics technologies and solutions for drug discovery, diagnosis, and food production in Japan. The company provides metabolome analysis services; and global profiling, targeted assays, flux analysis, and lipidomics services. Wesco Holdings Inc. engages in general construction consulting business in Japan. It is also involved in copying and binding, aquarium management, sports facility management, real estate, and public interest businesses. EnBio Holdings, Inc engages in soil and groundwater contamination, and renewable energy businesses in Japan. It imports and sells equipment, materials, and cleaning chemicals; and purchases, sells, and leases contaminated land. The company is also involved in soil contamination countermeasures, brownfield utilization, solar power generation, biomass power generation, water resources development, water treatment services, groundwater contamination treatment, and promoting ethical consumption. EnBio Holdings, Inc was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

MITRA Group, Inc. engages in transaction support in the fields of transaction procedures and settlements related to finance, real estate, and construction in Japan. FreakOut Holdings, inc., through its subsidiaries, offers advertising solutions in Japan and internationally. Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd. provides HR technology and business solutions that transforms the world of work. It operates through three segments: HR Technology, Staffing and Marketing Matching Technologies. The Staffing segment offers temporary staffing and other related services for clerical, manufacturing, light industry, and various professional positions across industries in Japan, Europe, the United States, and Australia. Elan Corporation engages in the nursing care business primarily in Japan. The company provides services for rental with laundry service of clothes, towels, diapers, and other daily necessities to persons admitted to hospital patients and nursing home residents. It also provides hospitalization and nursing care expenses guarantee services; and operates Elan Online Shop, a mail-order site for nursing care products. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Matsumoto, Japan. Elan Corporation is a subsidiary of M3, Inc.

Tsugami Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells precision machine tools in Japan. The company offers CNC precision automatic lathes, including independent opposed gang tool post, gang-tool post and turret, precision gang tool post, and vertical gang tool post; and CNC lathes.
